items.title_en: "Dear LLaVA, Please Drive": A Depth-Aware Vision-Language Agent for Closed-Loop Robotic Control
items.title_zh: “亲爱的LLaVA，请驾驶”：面向闭环机器人控制的深度感知视觉-语言智能体
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) provide a compelling foundation for reasoning-driven mobile navigation, offering rich contextual understanding and strong generalization from large-scale pretraining. Most existing navigation frameworks rely on imitation learning and therefore require substantial labeled trajectory data, limiting their scalability and robustness. In this work, we propose a parameter-efficient approach to fine-tune a pretrained VLM for autonomous navigation using an Imperative Learning paradigm. By optimizing against differentiable geometric cost fields rather than labeled trajectories, our model learns to generate collision-free paths exclusively from stereoscopic depth observations. We introduce a unified end-to-end navigation pipeline for natural-language-driven robotic control. This system leverages a shared VLM backbone with task-specific Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules, effectively bridging the gap from semantic target selection to low-level trajectory planning. Our approach achieves competitive Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) in unseen environments while updating less than 1% of the model's total parameters. Qualitative real-world experiments validate sim-to-real generalization and stable path planning without fine-tuning on real-world data. These results highlight a practical approach for deploying VLM-based agents on mobile robots, enabling high-level semantic navigation without the prohibitive requirement for large-scale, labeled trajectory data.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）具备丰富的上下文理解与大规模预训练带来的强泛化能力，为推理驱动的移动导航提供了理想基础。现有导航框架多依赖模仿学习，需要大量带标注的轨迹数据，可扩展性与鲁棒性受限。本文提出一种参数高效的方法，采用“命令式学习”（Imperative Learning）范式微调预训练 VLM 以完成自主导航：模型不拟合标注轨迹，而是针对可微的几何代价场进行优化，仅凭立体深度观测即可学会生成无碰撞路径。作者构建了面向自然语言驱动机器人控制的统一端到端导航流水线，共享同一 VLM 主干并挂载任务专属的 LoRA 模块，打通从语义目标选取到底层轨迹规划的链路。在未见环境中取得有竞争力的 SPL 指标，而更新的参数量不足模型总参数的 1%；真实世界定性实验验证了仿真到现实的泛化能力，无需真实数据微调即可稳定规划路径。
items.highlight_zh: 以可微几何代价场替代轨迹标签，仅调不到1%参数实现无碰撞导航
items.digest_zh: 这篇论文想解决的问题是：让机器人听懂人话去导航，通常要么缺泛化能力，要么得靠大量人工标注的“示范轨迹”来训练，成本高且换个环境就容易失灵。作者换了个思路——不要求模型模仿别人的走法，而是让它直接对着“几何代价场”优化。所谓代价场，就是用数学形式描述哪里离障碍近、哪里危险，并且可以求导，于是模型能从立体相机得到的深度图中自己学会怎么绕开障碍、生成不碰撞的路径。方法上，他们把一个大视觉-语言模型（类似 LLaVA 这种能看图又懂语言的模型）当作“大脑”，用 LoRA 这种只训练少量附加参数的技术做微调，让同一主干下挂不同小模块分别负责“听懂指令选目标”和“规划具体怎么走”，拼成一条端到端流水线。结果方面，在训练时没见过的陌生环境里，用 SPL（综合考虑成功率和路径是否走捷径的指标）衡量表现不俗，而可训练参数不到全模型的百分之一，非常省算力；真机实验中即使不用真实世界数据再调，也能稳定规划路线，说明从仿真迁移到现实是可行的。意义在于：它证明了不必堆海量标注轨迹，靠可求导的几何约束加上预训练模型的常识，就能把“你说去哪儿”直接变成“机器人怎么开”，为在移动机器人上低成本部署 VLM 智能体提供了一条务实路径。

rm.usage: 用VLM加深度代价场做语义导航，与哨兵全自动导航的路线差异较大：哨兵在已知的RMUC/RMUL小场地内跑定位、建图和路径规划，不需要自然语言指令，机载算力也难支撑VLM推理；只能借鉴“用可微几何代价场替代轨迹标注”的训练思路，用来离线生成避障用局部轨迹，关联较弱。

items.title_en: RangeNav: Task-Aligned LiDAR Range-Image Pretraining for Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: RangeNav：面向机器人导航的任务对齐LiDAR距离图像预训练
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots operating in dense crowds and cluttered sites require $360^\circ$ perception to react to surrounding hazards. While panoramic LiDAR offers full-surround coverage, learning representations within reinforcement learning (RL) is sample-inefficient under sparse rewards, and existing 3D pretrained point-cloud encoders are too memory-heavy for massively parallel RL simulation. We present RangeNav, a compact (183k parameters) LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data. RangeNav uses anisotropic convolutions and circular padding to handle the extreme aspect ratio and azimuthal seam of range images. We pretrain the network using a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) prediction, then freeze it for policy learning. In simulation, adding semantic and BEV supervision increases success rates over a reconstruction-only baseline by an average of 32.03 and 23.73 percentage points (pp) in procedurally generated training and out-of-distribution realistic test environments, respectively. Zero-shot real-world deployments on a Unitree B2-W quadruped demonstrate robust navigation through dense crowds, low-light settings, and construction zones where limited-field-of-view depth policies struggle. Code and models will be open-sourced. Project website: https://rangenav.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 密集人群与杂乱场地中的移动机器人需要360°感知。全景LiDAR可全向覆盖，但强化学习在稀疏奖励下样本效率低，现有3D预训练点云编码器显存开销大，难用于大规模并行仿真。本文提出RangeNav：仅183k参数的紧凑LiDAR距离图像编码器，完全用合成数据预训练；以各向异性卷积和循环填充处理距离图像的极端长宽比与方位接缝，并用距离重建、语义分割和BEV预测的导航对齐目标预训练，再冻结用于策略学习。仿真中，相较仅重建基线，语义与BEV监督在训练和分布外真实感测试环境分别平均提升成功率32.03和23.73个百分点。真实四足机器人零样本部署可在密集人群、低光和施工区稳健导航。
items.highlight_zh: 183k参数LiDAR预训练显著提升导航成功率
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：在人群密集、施工区等复杂场景中，机器人需要360°环视才能及时避障；但直接用强化学习从稀疏奖励中学习LiDAR表征很费样本，而常见3D点云预训练模型又太占显存，难以在成千上万个并行仿真环境中训练。
2. 方法：作者把全景LiDAR数据转成“距离图像”，设计仅183k参数的轻量编码器RangeNav。它用各向异性卷积和循环填充，专门应对距离图像又宽又扁、左右边界需无缝衔接的特点；预训练目标不是单纯重建距离，而是同时做距离重建、语义分割和BEV预测，使表征更贴近导航决策；预训练后冻结编码器，只训练导航策略。
3. 结果：仿真中，相比只做重建预训练，加入语义分割和BEV监督使成功率在程序生成训练环境平均提高32.03个百分点，在分布外真实感测试环境提高23.73个百分点。真实Unitree B2-W四足机器人零样本部署可穿过密集人群、低光环境和施工区，而视场有限的深度策略容易失败。
4. 意义：说明小模型+任务对齐的合成数据预训练，可为并行RL仿真提供省显存、可迁移的LiDAR感知表征，降低真实机器人导航对大量真实数据和算力的依赖。
items.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Added project website to abstract and updated author affiliation; research content unchanged

rm.usage: 183k参数的轻量LiDAR距离图像编码器可作哨兵360°激光感知的骨干：先合成数据预训练、再冻结后训练策略，适合RM哨兵低算力、需环视避障与多机对抗场景；但需要根据哨兵实际雷达型号与场地重训策略，不自带战术奖励。

items.title_en: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
items.title_zh: 打通视觉-语言推理与学习控制：面向野外环境的足式机器人导航
items.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility), a system that enables legged robots to perform kilometer-scale navigation in complex alpine and urban settings. ROAM combines the world knowledge of a Vision-Language Model (VLM), pre-trained on internet-scale data, with robust locomotion and local planning policies learned in simulation via reinforcement learning (RL). The VLM provides common-sense reasoning and semantic interpretation of the scene, assessing risks, interpreting signs, and producing semantic labels with associated navigation costs. An open-vocabulary segmentation module converts these labels into a dense, real-time risk map, which conditions two pre-trained RL policies responsible for agile locomotion and local navigation, effectively coupling high-level VLM reasoning with low-level physical control. Real-world experiments showed the system's ability to autonomously navigate a wide range of complex real-world environments. The robot completes kilometer-long hikes with minimal intervention, interprets signs to avoid danger, and evaluates its environment to identify safe areas on which to step. This work represents a step toward the reliable deployment of systems in unstructured environments. However, it also underscores the challenges that remain in VLM reliability and spatial reasoning, indicating that foundational models are a crucial component but not yet a complete solution for navigation in the wild.
items.abstract_zh: 在多样的真实环境中自主导航是机器人领域的重大挑战，既需要应对复杂地形的稳健底层运动控制，也需要理解环境线索的高层推理能力。本文提出 ROAM（Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility）系统，使足式机器人能够在复杂的山地与城市场景中完成公里级导航。ROAM 将互联网规模数据预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）所具备的世界知识与仿真中通过强化学习（RL）训练的运动与局部规划策略相结合：VLM 提供常识推理与场景语义解读，评估风险、识别路牌并输出带导航代价的语义标签；开放词表分割模块将这些标签转成稠密实时风险地图，用以调节两个预训练 RL 策略——分别负责敏捷运动与局部导航，从而将高层 VLM 推理与低层物理控制耦合起来。真实实验显示，机器人能在极少人工干预下完成公里级徒步，识别路牌避险，并评估地形以选择安全落脚点，但也暴露出 VLM 在可靠性与空间推理上的不足。
items.highlight_zh: VLM常识推理＋RL运动控制，让足式机器人野外自主徒步数公里
items.digest_zh: 论文要解决的问题是：四足机器人在真实野外走远路很难——山地里既有台阶、碎石、陡坡这类需要“会走”的硬功夫，也有读路牌、判断哪块地能踩这类需要“会想”的软功夫，而现有系统往往只擅长其中一半。作者提出 ROAM 系统，把两件事分工再拼起来：一半是“大脑”，用在海量网络数据上预训练过的视觉-语言模型，它对图像有常识，能说出“这是悬崖边”“这是禁止通行”“这里像草坪可以走”，并给每个语义标签附一个通行代价；另一半是“小脑和腿”，在仿真中用强化学习练出来的两个策略网络，一个管迈腿平衡，一个管局部绕障。中间的桥梁是开放词表分割模型——它把语言模型吐出的名词（哪怕训练时没见过）在画面上圈出对应区域，实时生成一张密集的“风险地图”，再喂给控制策略来调整动作。实机结果上，机器人能在阿尔卑斯山地和城市环境中几乎无人工干预地连续走完数公里，会看牌子避让危险，会判断哪里落脚安全。其重要性在于示范了一条混合路线：不必把一切都塞进一个大模型，而是让 VLM 负责“理解与决策”、RL 负责“执行与反应”。但作者也坦白，VLM 有时会看错、空间推理不够准，说明基础模型是必要组件，却还不足以单独兜底野外导航。
items.comment: 42 pages, 6 figures, 15 supplementary figures. Author's version of the article published in Science Robotics. Project page: https://roam-hiking.github.io

items.title_en: Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments
items.title_zh: 面向工业环境的移动操作机器人技术报告
items.abstract_en: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍 Shahid Beheshti 大学机器人与智能自动化实验室为 Auriga Robotics 开发的工业移动操作机器人 @Work Robot 的设计与实现。该平台面向重复或危险工业任务，采用四轮 Mecanum 驱动实现全向移动，配备 5 自由度机械臂和 3D 打印夹爪。电子系统包括基于 ESP32 的定制 PCB 与负责高层处理和实时控制的 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX。软件采用 Hector SLAM 建图定位、A* 路径规划和 YOLO 实时目标检测，并融合传感器数据实现稳健导航与避障。系统在类工业环境中的自主导航、物体操作和任务执行中展现出良好的软硬件集成与稳定性能。
items.highlight_zh: 集成Hector SLAM、A*与YOLO的工业移动操作平台
items.digest_zh: 这篇技术报告要解决的问题是：工业环境中存在大量重复、危险或劳动强度高的工作，需要能自主移动并操作物体的机器人平台。作者设计并实现了 @Work Robot：底盘采用四轮 Mecanum 驱动，可全向移动；上部是 5 自由度机械臂和 3D 打印夹爪，用于抓取和操作。电子系统用基于 ESP32 的定制 PCB 板连接底层设备，并用 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 承担高层计算和实时控制。软件栈包括 Hector SLAM 做建图与定位、A* 做路径规划、YOLO 做实时目标检测，再把多传感器数据融合起来，支撑导航和避障。报告的结果是系统在类工业场景中能完成自主导航、物体处理和任务执行，性能较稳定，说明软硬件集成方案可行。其意义在于为工业重复/危险作业的自动化提供了一个可落地的移动操作机器人参考平台，并展示了感知、规划与执行模块协同工作的完整链路。
items.comment: 25 pages, 22 figures, 4 tables. Technical report of Team Auriga's 2025 mobile manipulator (@Work) platform (Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Shahid Beheshti University)

items.title_en: Omni-IGN: Onboard Image-Goal Navigation for Drones with Omnidirectional Vision
items.title_zh: Omni-IGN：面向无人机的全向视觉机载图像目标导航
items.abstract_en: Image-goal navigation (ImageNav) requires an agent to reach a location specified by a goal image in an unknown environment. For drones, this task demands exploration, goal- directed navigation, and collision avoidance under limited onboard computing resources. Existing aerial ImageNav methods are built on single-view observations, requiring additional rotation and exploration to search for goal-relevant cues outside the field of view. In this paper, we present Omni-IGN, a fully onboard ImageNav system that integrates quad-fisheye perception, an attention-based reinforcement learning (RL) policy, and a collision-aware safety layer. The policy adaptively fuses goal-relevant features across multiple views to provide directional guidance for continuous navigation. The quad-fisheye RGB images support both ImageNav and obstacle avoidance without a dedicated depth sensor. On Habitat benchmarks, Omni-IGN achieves the best performance among continuous-action baselines. Moreover, flight tests in IsaacSim validate the effectiveness of integrating learning-based depth estimation with the action safety layer for collision avoidance. Finally, real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer without any fine-tuning or external localization. The code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航（ImageNav）要求智能体在未知环境中抵达由目标图像指定的位置。对无人机而言，该任务需在有限机载算力下同时完成探索、目标导向导航与避障。现有空中 ImageNav 方法基于单视图观测，需要额外旋转与探索才能找到视野外的目标相关线索。本文提出 Omni-IGN，一个完全机载的 ImageNav 系统，融合四鱼眼感知、基于注意力的强化学习（RL）策略与碰撞感知安全层。策略自适应融合多视图中的目标相关特征，为连续导航提供方向引导；四鱼眼 RGB 图像同时支持 ImageNav 与避障，无需专用深度传感器。在 Habitat 基准上，Omni-IGN 在连续动作基线中表现最佳；IsaacSim 飞行测试验证了学习式深度估计与动作安全层结合用于避障的有效性；真实世界实验则展示了无需微调或外部定位的零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。
items.highlight_zh: 四鱼眼全向视觉+注意力 RL+安全层，实现无人机零样本真机导航
items.digest_zh:
- 研究了什么问题：图像目标导航（ImageNav）要求智能体只看一张目标照片，就在陌生环境里走到那个位置。对无人机更难：要在机载有限算力下同时完成探索、朝目标飞和避障。现有空中方案多为单视图，视野外的目标线索只能靠原地转圈和额外探索去找，效率低。
- 用了什么方法：作者提出 Omni-IGN，一个全部跑在机上的系统，由三部分组成：四个鱼眼相机组成的全向 RGB 感知（不装专用深度传感器）、基于注意力的强化学习策略、以及碰撞感知的安全层。策略自适应地在多个视角间融合目标相关特征，输出连续控制指令；同一套鱼眼图像既用于导航也用于判断障碍。安全层借助基于学习的深度估计对动作做碰撞过滤。
- 得到什么结果：在 Habitat 基准上，Omni-IGN 在连续动作基线中表现最好。IsaacSim 飞行测试验证了“学习式深度估计 + 动作安全层”确实能有效避障。真机实验中实现了零样本 sim-to-real：不微调、也不用外部定位系统就能飞行。
- 为何重要：全向视觉让无人机“看一眼就够”，省掉了为扩大视野而做的机动与探索；把安全层与学习策略解耦，也使仿真训练的策略更容易迁移到真机，对算力受限的机载平台尤其有意义。

rm.usage: 全机载、不依赖外部定位的四目鱼眼图像目标导航，可参考其多视角特征融合策略与碰撞感知安全层，用于空中机器人机库视觉返航与飞行避障；但它是“给定目标图像”的导航任务，需按RM机库引导与轻量算力重新训练与验证。

items.title_en: OASIS: Optimization-Aware Subgoal Inference with Safety Constraints for Autonomous Mobile Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: OASIS：面向自主移动机器人导航的优化感知子目标推理与安全约束
items.abstract_en: Navigation in dynamic environments requires mobile robots to make progress toward their goals while respecting motion limits and avoiding surrounding obstacles. Learned subgoal policies can guide model predictive control beyond its local prediction horizon, but a geometrically suitable subgoal does not necessarily lead to a successfully solved control problem. This paper proposes OASIS, a hierarchical navigation framework that incorporates recent optimization outcomes into reinforcement learning-based subgoal generation. A high-level policy trained using Soft Actor--Critic generates local subgoals, while a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks them subject to motion limits, geometric collision-avoidance constraints, and embedded high-order control barrier function constraints. The outcomes of controller optimizations over each subgoal interval are summarized and provided to the policy at its next decision, without requiring additional optimization calls. The framework is evaluated in five navigation scenarios with static and moving obstacles, including dense interactions and sensing uncertainty. Comparisons with hierarchical and direct-goal control variants show that OASIS achieves the highest aggregate navigation success. Matched comparisons across three training seeds further show a consistent success advantage over the otherwise identical hierarchy without optimization-status input. The selected-policy comparison also shows fewer primary optimization failures with similar mean controller time.
items.abstract_zh: 动态环境导航要求机器人朝目标推进，同时遵守运动限制并避障。学习型子目标策略可引导模型预测控制超越局部预测时域，但几何合适的子目标未必对应可求解的控制问题。本文提出 OASIS 分层框架，将近期优化结果纳入强化学习子目标生成：Soft Actor-Critic 高层策略产生局部子目标，非线性模型预测控制器在运动限制、几何避碰与高阶控制屏障函数约束下跟踪；各子目标区间的优化结果汇总后于下次决策输入策略，无需额外优化调用。五个含静态/移动障碍物、密集交互和感知不确定性的场景中，OASIS 总体成功率最高；三个训练种子下持续优于无优化状态输入的相同结构，主要优化失败更少且控制器时间相近。
items.highlight_zh: 用控制器优化状态反馈引导子目标生成，提升导航成功率
items.digest_zh:
1）问题：移动机器人在动态环境中导航时，既要朝目标前进，又要满足速度、转向等运动限制并避开障碍。模型预测控制（MPC）只看有限预测时域，容易陷入局部；已有工作让高层策略给出子目标来引导 MPC，但子目标“位置看起来合适”并不等于底层控制器能求出可行、安全的轨迹。
2）方法：作者提出 OASIS。高层用 Soft Actor-Critic 学习生成局部子目标；底层用非线性 MPC 跟踪，并显式加入运动限制、几何避碰约束以及高阶控制屏障函数约束来保障安全。关键点是“优化感知”：控制器在每个子目标区间求解后，把优化是否成功等结果汇总，作为下一次高层决策的额外输入，且不增加额外优化调用。
3）结果：在五个包含静态和移动障碍、密集交互与感知不确定性的导航场景中，OASIS 的总体导航成功率最高；与结构相同但缺少优化状态输入的版本在三个训练种子下对比，仍稳定占优；同时主要优化失败更少，平均控制器计算时间相近。
4）意义：它把“子目标生成”和“底层优化可行性”连接起来，让学习型高层不只追求几何上好看的目标，而是参考控制器实际能否求解，从而提升复杂动态环境下的导航可靠性。

items.title_en: RAVEN: A Unified Active SLAM System for Rapid Autonomous Visual Exploration with Aerial Robots under Localization Uncertainty
items.title_zh: RAVEN：面向空中机器人在定位不确定性下快速自主视觉探索的统一主动 SLAM 系统
items.abstract_en: Active simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) addresses the problem of planning robot motion to build complete and accurate maps of unknown environments through efficient exploration while maintaining high localization accuracy. This raises a dilemma between exploring unknown spaces to expand coverage and exploiting visited regions to perform active loop closures. Despite numerous prior works on ground robots, aerial robots with high agility and constrained sensor suites face more significant localization drift and thereby demand dedicated active SLAM planning. Moreover, a unified strategy that adapts performance based on task-specific priorities remains an open question. In this article, we introduce RAVEN, a unified active SLAM framework for Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN using quadrotors, which systematically accounts for localization uncertainty. The framework starts with identifying frontiers and active loop closure candidates, from which global tour candidates are generated. These candidates are evaluated using a utility vector that separately quantifies exploration efficiency and localization accuracy, and the final tour is selected according to a prioritization parameter ranging from $[0,1]$. Finally, a perception-aware navigation planner generates smooth execution trajectories that minimize visual state estimation error based on the online Fisher information field that provides visual localization information in real-time. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that RAVEN outperforms state-of-the-art active SLAM methods, highlighting its advantages in producing a spectrum of performance across prioritizations. Fully onboard field experiments with a customized stereo-inertial quadrotor further validate its practical applicability in challenging environments. The source code will be released to benefit the community.
items.abstract_zh: 主动同时定位与建图（SLAM）解决的是通过高效探索规划机器人运动，以在未知环境中构建完整、准确地图并保持高定位精度的问题。这带来了在探索未知空间以扩大覆盖与利用已访问区域进行主动回环闭合之间的两难。尽管地面机器人已有大量先前工作，但具有高敏捷性和受限传感器配置的空中机器人面临更显著的定位漂移，因而需要专门的主动 SLAM 规划。此外，能够根据任务特定优先级自适应调整性能的统一策略仍是一个开放问题。本文提出 RAVEN，一个用于四旋翼快速自主视觉探索（Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN）并系统考虑定位不确定性的统一主动 SLAM 框架。该框架首先识别前沿和主动回环闭合候选，并由此生成全局巡游候选。这些候选通过一个分别量化探索效率和定位精度的效用向量进行评估，最终巡游依据取值范围为 [0,1] 的优先级参数进行选择。最后，感知感知导航规划器基于实时提供视觉定位信息的在线 Fisher 信息场，生成使视觉状态估计误差最小化的平滑执行轨迹。基准评测表明 RAVEN 优于当前最先进的主动 SLAM 方法，凸显其在不同优先级下产生一系列性能表现的优势。使用定制立体-惯性四旋翼进行的完全机载现场实验进一步验证了其在挑战性环境中的实际适用性。源代码将发布以惠及社区。

items.title_en: Autonomous UAV Navigation in an Unknown Environment via Multi-Trajectory Model Predictive Control
items.title_zh: 未知环境中基于多轨迹模型预测控制的无人机自主导航
items.abstract_en: A novel model predictive control (MPC) formulation, named multi-trajectory MPC (mt-MPC), is presented and applied to the problem of autonomous navigation of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in an unknown environment. The UAV is equipped with a LiDAR sensor, providing only a partial description of the surroundings and resulting in time-varying constraints as the vehicle navigates among the obstacles. The control system layout is hierarchical: the low-level loops stabilize the vehicle's trajectories and track the set-points commanded by the high-level, mt-MPC controller. The latter is required to plan the UAV trajectory trading off safety, i.e. to avoid collisions with the uncertain obstacles, and exploitation, i.e. to reach an assigned target location. To achieve this goal, mt-MPC considers different future state trajectories in the same Finite Horizon Optimal Control Problem (FHOCP), enabling a partial decoupling between constraint satisfaction (safety) and cost function minimization (exploitation). Recursive feasibility and, consequently, persistent obstacle avoidance guarantees are derived under the assumption of a time invariant environment. The performance of the approach is studied in simulation and compared with that of a standard MPC, showing good improvement.
items.abstract_zh: 提出一种新的模型预测控制（MPC）形式，称为多轨迹MPC（mt-MPC），并将其应用于无人机（UAV）在未知环境中的自主导航问题。无人机配备LiDAR传感器，仅提供周围环境的局部描述，导致飞行器在障碍物间导航时产生时变约束。控制系统采用分层结构：底层回路稳定飞行器轨迹并跟踪高层mt-MPC控制器指令的设定点。后者需要规划无人机轨迹，在安全性（即避免与不确定障碍物碰撞）和利用性（即到达指定目标位置）之间权衡。为实现该目标，mt-MPC在同一个有限时域最优控制问题（FHOCP）中考虑不同的未来状态轨迹，从而在约束满足（安全性）与代价函数最小化（利用性）之间实现部分解耦。在环境时不变的假设下，推导了递归可行性以及由此得到的持续避障保证。通过仿真研究了该方法的性能，并与标准MPC进行比较，显示出良好改进。

items.title_en: Sample-Efficient Model Predictive Control via Proximal Policy Optimization
items.title_zh: 通过近端策略优化实现样本高效的模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) enables real-time control of complex nonlinear systems but often incurs substantial computational costs due to repeated trajectory simulations. In this paper, we bridge policy optimization in reinforcement learning and sampling-based MPC to improve computational efficiency through sample reuse. Starting from a KL-regularized distributional formulation of trajectory optimization, we derive an exact performance-difference identity based on a signed exponential advantage function. This identity motivates two algorithms, PPO-MPPI and SPO-MPPI, which adapt proximal policy optimization techniques to sampling-based MPC, enabling multiple optimization updates using previously evaluated trajectories without additional forward simulations. We establish population-level monotonic improvement guarantees for both methods and prove convergence to first-order stationarity for PPO-MPPI under fixed-covariance Gaussian sampling distributions. Experiments on quadruped velocity tracking and quadrotor path tracking demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve competitive control performance at substantially lower computational cost than multi-stage sampling approaches. Our results establish a principled connection between policy optimization and sampling-based MPC and highlight the potential of trajectory reuse for sample-efficient predictive control.
items.abstract_zh: 基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）能够对复杂非线性系统进行实时控制，但由于重复轨迹仿真，通常会产生大量计算成本。本文将强化学习中的策略优化与基于采样的MPC联系起来，通过样本复用来提高计算效率。从轨迹优化的KL正则化分布形式出发，我们推导出基于带符号指数优势函数的精确性能差恒等式。该恒等式启发了两种算法PPO-MPPI和SPO-MPPI，它们将近端策略优化技术适配到基于采样的MPC，使得能够利用先前评估过的轨迹进行多次优化更新，而无需额外的前向仿真。我们为两种方法建立了群体层面的单调改进保证，并在固定协方差高斯采样分布下证明了PPO-MPPI收敛到一阶平稳性。在四足机器人速度跟踪和四旋翼路径跟踪上的实验表明，所提方法以显著低于多阶段采样方法的计算成本实现了有竞争力的控制性能。我们的结果在策略优化与基于采样的MPC之间建立了有原则的联系，并突出了轨迹复用于样本高效预测控制的潜力。

items.title_en: Embedded Sim-to-Real Visual Servoing: Learned Reaching and Force-Guided Placement
items.title_zh: 嵌入式仿真到现实视觉伺服：学习式接近与力引导放置
items.abstract_en: Embedded perception-to-control systems must combine visual targeting with reliable contact handling under tight computational constraints. We present a shared architecture on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin controlling a Franka Research 3 through Cartesian impedance control. RealSense D435i observations, YOLO11-seg segmentation, depth back-projection, and hand--eye calibration provide metric robot-frame targets. We compare two strategies: compact proximal policy optimization (PPO) policies transferred from simulation for object- and hole-region reaching, and force-guided Cartesian placement using approximately 2 N normal contact and spiral search. The PPO policies achieved 87.2% and 83.1% success over 1000 simulation episodes each. Across 50 real-robot trials per strategy, the learned hybrid and force-guided analytical pipelines achieved 70.0% and 74.0% completion, respectively. Mean perception latency with TensorRT was 34.55 ms. These results support an embedded architecture combining learned free-space reaching with explicit contact correction.
items.abstract_zh: 嵌入式感知到控制系统必须在严格的计算约束下，将视觉目标定位与可靠的接触处理相结合。我们提出一种在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上通过笛卡尔阻抗控制操纵Franka Research 3的共享架构。RealSense D435i观测、YOLO11-seg分割、深度反投影以及手眼标定提供机器人坐标系下的度量目标。我们比较两种策略：从仿真迁移而来的紧凑近端策略优化（PPO）策略，用于物体区域和孔洞区域的接近；以及使用约2 N法向接触和螺旋搜索的力引导笛卡尔放置。PPO策略在各自1000个仿真回合上的成功率为87.2%和83.1%。在每种策略50次真实机器人试验中，学习式混合流程和力引导分析流程分别达到70.0%和74.0%的完成率。使用TensorRT的平均感知延迟为34.55 ms。这些结果支持一种将学习式自由空间接近与显式接触校正相结合的嵌入式架构。

items.title_en: Teaching a Tree to Recover: Online Distillation of an LLM Supervisor with Counterfactual Replay
items.title_zh: 教一棵树恢复：利用反事实回放的LLM监督器在线蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots commonly pair a global planner with a local model predictive controller (MPC), but nonconvex obstacle avoidance and a limited horizon can make the robot freeze in complex layouts. Deciding whether to replan, wait, or call for help is a supervisory decision. Recent work queries a large language model (LLM) supervisor on every anomaly, which is slow and costly. We instead distill the LLM online into a decision tree. After each training episode, counterfactual replay labels recoveries as needed, unnecessary, or harmful. These labels retire unhelpful rules. In simulation, on 20 unseen layouts where the MPC alone freezes, the tree handles at least 18 correctly across all seeds, either by reaching the goal or by calling for help when no feasible path exists. The tree matches both an always-query LLM supervisor and expert-designed rules, while issuing no LLM queries at test time. Handwritten rules cannot anticipate the long tail of situations a physical robot will encounter. Online distillation is a promising remedy: the tree handles familiar cases, and the LLM is consulted only for new ones, whose validated recoveries become new rules. Language models can thus also serve as designers of supervisors rather than only as runtime supervisors.
items.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人通常将全局规划器与局部模型预测控制器（MPC）配对，但非凸避障和有限时域可能导致机器人在复杂布局中冻结。决定是重新规划、等待还是求助，是一项监督决策。近期工作在每个异常发生时都查询大语言模型（LLM）监督器，这既慢又昂贵。我们改为将LLM在线蒸馏为决策树。在每个训练回合后，反事实回放将恢复操作标注为需要、不必要或有害。这些标签会淘汰无用的规则。在仿真中，对于仅靠MPC会冻结的20个未见布局，该决策树在所有随机种子下至少正确处理18个，要么到达目标，要么在不存在可行路径时求助。该决策树与始终查询的LLM监督器和专家设计的规则均相匹配，同时在测试时不发出任何LLM查询。手写规则无法预见物理机器人将遇到的长尾情况。在线蒸馏是一种有前景的补救方法：决策树处理熟悉情况，仅对新情况咨询LLM，而经过验证的恢复操作会成为新规则。因此，语言模型也可以充当监督器的设计者，而不仅是运行时监督器。

items.title_en: VisGeo-PipeTrack: A Visual Geometric Servo Control Framework with MPC-RCAPID Control for UAV-Based Dynamic Pipes Tracking
items.title_zh: VisGeo-PipeTrack：一种基于MPC-RCAPID控制的无人机动态管道跟踪视觉几何伺服控制框架
items.abstract_en: While unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for pipeline inspection, prevailing research predominantly assumes static pipes. In real-world industrial environments, pipes often exhibit dynamic movements, such as vibrations. This imposes more stringent requirements on UAVs' adaptive control and computational efficiency than in static scenarios. Therefore, this paper proposes a servo control framework named VisGeo-PipeTrack, which utilizes geometric constraints to enable UAV tracking of dynamic pipes. To achieve efficient UAV positioning, YOLOv5 is employed to detect labels on the pipe. The positions are derived from visual geometric constraints based on these detected labels to enable precise localization. To address tracking control challenges, a model predictive control based real-time corrected adaptive PID (MPC-RCAPID) controller is proposed. This controller employs the Recursive Least Squares method for real-time model estimation and integrates rolling horizon optimization to dynamically adjust PID parameters. Experiments conducted on both the AirSim simulator and the Tello UAV platform validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Simulation comparisons with standard PID, fractional-order PID, adaptive PID, and fuzzy PID demonstrate that MPC-RCAPID achieves the shortest settling time (3.26 s) and the lowest average tracking error (3.52%). In physical experiments on the Tello platform, compared with standard PID control, MPC-RCAPID reduces the average tracking error by 55.52%, 26.72%, and 26.52% across the three test dimensions. These results demonstrate that VisGeo-PipeTrack facilitates efficient autonomous tracking in dynamic pipe environments.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管无人机（UAV）越来越多地被部署用于管道巡检，但现有研究大多假设管道是静态的。在实际工业环境中，管道常常表现出动态运动，例如振动。与静态场景相比，这对无人机的自适应控制和计算效率提出了更严格的要求。因此，本文提出了一种名为VisGeo-PipeTrack的伺服控制框架，利用几何约束使无人机能够跟踪动态管道。为实现高效的无人机定位，采用YOLOv5检测管道上的标签。基于这些检测到的标签，通过视觉几何约束推导位置，以实现精确定位。为应对跟踪控制挑战，提出了一种基于模型预测控制的实时校正自适应PID（MPC-RCAPID）控制器。该控制器采用递归最小二乘法进行实时模型估计，并结合滚动时域优化动态调整PID参数。在AirSim仿真器和Tello无人机平台上进行的实验验证了所提框架的有效性。与标准PID、分数阶PID、自适应PID和模糊PID的仿真对比表明，MPC-RCAPID实现了最短的调节时间（3.26 s）和最低的平均跟踪误差（3.52%）。在Tello平台上的物理实验中，与标准PID控制相比，MPC-RCAPID在三个测试维度上分别将平均跟踪误差降低了55.52%、26.72%和26.52%。这些结果表明，VisGeo-PipeTrack有助于在动态管道环境中实现高效的自主跟踪。

items.title_en: A ROS2 based Human-In-The-Loop Framework for UAV Search and Rescue Operations
items.title_zh: 基于ROS2的无人机搜救人在回路框架
items.abstract_en: Existing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) autonomy frameworks lack human contextual awareness, limiting real-time adaptability in unstructured Search and Rescue (SAR) environments. To address data availability, we propose a Robot Operating System (ROS2)-based human-in-the-loop (HITL) framework that translates human directional gestures (left/right) into UAV navigation commands using RGB-Depth (RGB-D) sensing and YOLOv11 (You Only Look Once). The deprecation of ROS1 necessitates migrating to ROS2, prioritising real-time communication, scalability, and long-term maintainability. Unlike approaches optimised for peak accuracy under ideal conditions, the proposed system prioritises robustness and real-time deployment in degraded SAR environments. Our system achieves 89% confidence in depth estimation under occlusion and varying environmental conditions in Gazebo-PX4 simulations. In foggy conditions, RGB-D fusion consistently provides more informative cues than RGB alone, with an average improvement of 46.7% across all scenarios and distances. The framework demonstrates superior occlusion handling (+15%), adaptive RGB-D fusion, temporal consistency modelling, and real-time deployment via a ROS2 data distribution service (DDS), with end-to-end latency below 50 ms. We evaluate the modified YOLOv11 and the depth-weighted pose estimation on a held-out simulated test set and on real people from the public UAV-GESTURE dataset, in clear air and in Koschmieder fog. Without retraining, the framework reads the gestures of real people with 80% accuracy, depth keeps 77% at a visibility of 10 m where RGB drops to 24%, and the modified YOLOv11 reaches 91% in simulation and 99% on held-out real people when trained on real data. The open-source ROS2 implementation eases the transition of SAR-UAV platforms from ROS1, enabling UAVs to act directly on operator gestures without complex path planning.
items.abstract_zh: 现有的无人机（UAV）自主框架缺乏人的情境感知，限制了在非结构化搜救（SAR）环境中的实时适应性。为解决数据可用性问题，我们提出一种基于机器人操作系统（ROS2）的人在回路（HITL）框架，利用RGB-深度（RGB-D）传感和YOLOv11（You Only Look Once）将人的方向手势（左/右）转换为无人机导航指令。ROS1的弃用使得迁移到ROS2成为必要，优先考虑实时通信、可扩展性和长期可维护性。与在理想条件下追求峰值精度的方法不同，所提系统优先考虑退化SAR环境中的鲁棒性和实时部署。在Gazebo-PX4仿真中，我们的系统在遮挡和变化环境条件下深度估计达到89%的置信度。在雾天条件下，RGB-D融合始终比仅RGB提供更有信息量的线索，在所有场景和距离上平均提升46.7%。该框架展示了更优的遮挡处理（+15%）、自适应RGB-D融合、时间一致性建模，以及通过ROS2数据分发服务（DDS）的实时部署，端到端延迟低于50 ms。我们在留出的仿真测试集以及公开UAV-GESTURE数据集中的真人上，在晴空和Koschmieder雾条件下评估了修改后的YOLOv11和深度加权姿态估计。无需重新训练，该框架读取真人的手势准确率为80%；在能见度10 m处，RGB降至24%时深度仍保持77%；当在真实数据上训练时，修改后的YOLOv11在仿真中达到91%，在留出的真人上达到99%。开源的ROS2实现减轻了SAR-UAV平台从ROS1迁移的负担，使无人机能够直接根据操作员手势行动，而无需复杂的路径规划。

items.title_en: Distributed Interactive Conformal Prediction for Multi-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: 多智能体系统的分布式交互式共形预测
items.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems increasingly rely on learning-enabled components and distributed algorithms for perception, estimation, and control, introducing uncertainty that makes it challenging to satisfy mission requirements. Conformal prediction quantifies uncertainty with distribution-free guarantees, but existing methods do not address the challenging combination of dependence among robots, distributed calibration, and the distribution shift induced when calibrated uncertainty bounds modify the closed-loop system. We introduce Multi-Agent Interactive Conformal Prediction (MA-ICP), a distributed framework for computing robustness margins in heterogeneous systems to satisfy mission requirements with high probability. MA-ICP aggregates robot-level nonconformity scores, which measure errors in modeled or estimated quantities, into one mission-level score per robot class, allowing dependence among robots within each mission. Mission-level scores and quantiles are computed using neighbor-to-neighbor communication in a finite number of communication rounds. Updating the robustness margins changes robot trajectories and distributed algorithm outputs, so we use class-dependent score sensitivities to upper bound the shift in mission-level scores. We then establish calibration-conditional coverage guarantees per robot class for the updated margins. We demonstrate MA-ICP on cooperative payload control, formation control with obstacle avoidance, and distributed target tracking missions.
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体系统越来越多地依赖学习使能组件和分布式算法进行感知、估计和控制，这引入了不确定性，使得满足任务要求具有挑战性。共形预测以无分布保证量化不确定性，但现有方法未能解决机器人间依赖性、分布式校准以及校准后的不确定性边界修改闭环系统所引发的分布偏移这一具有挑战性的组合。我们提出多智能体交互式共形预测（MA-ICP），一个用于在异构系统中计算鲁棒性裕度以高概率满足任务要求的分布式框架。MA-ICP将机器人级非一致性分数（衡量建模或估计量的误差）聚合为每个机器人类别的一个任务级分数，从而允许每个任务内机器人间的依赖性。任务级分数和分位数通过有限轮数的邻居间通信计算。更新鲁棒性裕度会改变机器人轨迹和分布式算法输出，因此我们使用类别相关的分数敏感性来对任务级分数的偏移进行上界。然后，我们为更新后的裕度建立每个机器人类别的校准条件覆盖保证。我们在协作载荷控制、带避障的编队控制和分布式目标跟踪任务上演示了MA-ICP。

items.title_en: JAX-Nano: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver for Nanoscale Heat Transfer
items.title_zh: JAX-Nano：用于纳米尺度传热的GPU加速可微声子玻尔兹曼输运求解器
items.abstract_en: As semiconductor device dimensions approach phonon mean free paths, heat transport enters ballistic and quasi-ballistic regimes where Fourier's law becomes inadequate. The phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) describes these nonequilibrium effects but presents significant computational challenges. This work introduces JAX-Nano, a GPU-accelerated, end-to-end differentiable phonon BTE solver for nanoscale heat transport. The solver integrates steady-state and transient BTE formulations within a unified finite-volume framework, supporting structured and unstructured meshes, mode-resolved transport, phonon scattering, volumetric heat generation, and multiple boundary conditions. Automatic differentiation enables gradient computation with respect to transport properties, boundary conditions, heat-generation rates, and geometric parameters without separately derived adjoint equations. Numerical predictions are validated against analytical solutions and established BTE solvers across diffusive-to-ballistic regimes. Applications to complex three-dimensional geometries are demonstrated using single-fin, double-fin, and arrayed fin field-effect transistor (FinFET) configurations. Gradient-based inverse learning enables single- and multi-parameter identification, including simultaneous recovery of mode-resolved phonon relaxation times and spatially distributed heat-generation rates in steady-state and transient problems. GPU performance and scalability are evaluated with respect to spatial resolution, angular discretization, and phonon bands, including comparisons with an MPI-based BTE solver. JAX-Nano provides a unified computational framework for three-dimensional phonon transport, automatic differentiation, and inverse parameter identification, enabling sensitivity analysis and optimization of nanoscale thermal systems.
items.abstract_zh: 随着半导体器件尺寸接近声子平均自由程，热输运进入弹道和准弹道区域，此时傅里叶定律变得不再适用。声子玻尔兹曼输运方程（BTE）描述了这些非平衡效应，但带来了显著的计算挑战。本文提出JAX-Nano，一种用于纳米尺度热输运的GPU加速、端到端可微声子BTE求解器。该求解器在统一的有限体积框架内集成稳态和瞬态BTE公式，支持结构化和非结构化网格、模式分辨输运、声子散射、体热生成以及多种边界条件。自动微分能够计算关于输运性质、边界条件、热生成率和几何参数的梯度，而无需单独推导伴随方程。数值预测在扩散到弹道区域范围内与解析解和现有BTE求解器进行验证。使用单鳍、双鳍和阵列鳍场效应晶体管（FinFET）配置展示了在复杂三维几何中的应用。基于梯度的逆学习支持单参数和多参数辨识，包括在稳态和瞬态问题中同时恢复模式分辨的声子弛豫时间与空间分布的热生成率。针对空间分辨率、角度离散化和声子能带评估GPU性能与可扩展性，包括与基于MPI的BTE求解器进行比较。JAX-Nano为三维声子输运、自动微分和逆参数辨识提供统一计算框架，从而支持纳米尺度热系统的敏感性分析和优化。

items.title_en: A Hybrid Multi-Goal Path Planning Framework for Powered Wheelchairs in Dynamic Environments: From Simulation to Real-World Validation
items.title_zh: 动态环境中电动轮椅的混合多目标路径规划框架：从仿真到真实世界验证
items.abstract_en: Autonomous powered wheelchairs (PWs) operating in human-centered environments must combine efficient multi-destination path planning with continuous collision avoidance strategies in the presence of static and dynamic obstacles. This study presents a hybrid framework integrating Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP)-based global task ordering, Potential-Field (PF) guidance, and local Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) and A-star (A*) planners. PF guidance transfers global path information to local planners, helping the robot stay aligned with the global path during obstacle avoidance. Local planning is enhanced with direction-aware, extended-neighborhood A* or RRT using environment-aware sampling and two-step extension. The TSP-PF-RRT and TSP-PF-A* methods are evaluated in normal, crowded, and extra-crowded simulation environments using point-based and elliptical robot models. The elliptical model accounts for platform dimensions during collision avoidance phase. Hardware tests on the physical PW use motion capture (MoCap) for ground-truth measurements, while outside-MoCap experiments rely on onboard LiDAR and RGB-D sensing. Results show that incorporating the wheelchair geometry changes the observed collision behavior, yielding comparable collision avoidance performance between the two hybrid planners under the elliptical model.
items.abstract_zh: 在以人为中心的环境中运行的自主电动轮椅（PWs）必须在存在静态和动态障碍物的情况下，将高效的多目的地路径规划与持续避碰策略相结合。本研究提出一种混合框架，集成基于旅行商问题（TSP）的全局任务排序、势场（PF）引导以及局部快速探索随机树（RRT）和A*规划器。PF引导将全局路径信息传递给局部规划器，帮助机器人在避障过程中保持与全局路径对齐。局部规划通过方向感知、扩展邻域的A*或RRT得到增强，采用环境感知采样和两步扩展。在正常、拥挤和极度拥挤的仿真环境中，使用基于点的和椭圆形机器人模型对TSP-PF-RRT与TSP-PF-A*方法进行评估。椭圆形模型在避碰阶段考虑平台尺寸。在物理PW上的硬件测试使用运动捕捉（MoCap）进行真值测量，而在MoCap范围外的实验依赖机载LiDAR和RGB-D传感。结果表明，纳入轮椅几何形状会改变观察到的碰撞行为，在椭圆形模型下两种混合规划器产生相当的避碰性能。
items.comment: This work is under review at the International Journal of Social Robotics. The manuscript extends arXiv:2610.42049 by introducing an elliptical wheelchair model, enhanced local planning methods, and hardware validation

items.title_en: AELF: Active Terrain-Aware UAV Exploration Using a Lightweight Framework
items.title_zh: AELF：基于轻量级框架的主动地形感知无人机探索
items.abstract_en: This paper presents an efficient and robust approach for autonomous aerial exploration in complex environments. Instead of relying on conventional 3D voxel-based maps for exploration, we utilize a lightweight 2.5D map framework that reduces computational overhead while preserving essential topographic information. More importantly, this representation systematically eliminates the blind voxel problem commonly encountered in voxel-based exploration due to occlusions and limited visibility. Unlike previous methods that rely on a fixed altitude scale for exploration, our approach requires no prior height information and actively adapts to terrain elevation changes during exploration. To further enhance exploration efficiency while preserving the generality of 3D exploration, we perform 2D path planning on the 2.5D map framework, which is then lifted to 3D to evaluate the cost between viewpoints by taking into account terrain traversability, thereby reducing frequent altitude changes and enabling smoother exploration. Extensive experiments conducted in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate the effectiveness and advantages of our approach over existing solutions. Our approach demonstrates fast exploration of over 2000~$\text{m}^2$ of cluttered forest and sloped mountainous terrain with elevation changes of up to 10~m, reaching a maximum speed of 5~m/s in real-world tests.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种在复杂环境中进行自主空中探索的高效且稳健的方法。该方法不依赖传统的三维体素地图进行探索，而是采用轻量级2.5D地图框架，在降低计算开销的同时保留必要的地形信息。更重要的是，这种表示系统性地消除了基于体素的探索中因遮挡和可见性受限而常见的盲体素问题。与以往依赖固定高度尺度进行探索的方法不同，我们的方法无需先验高度信息，并在探索过程中主动适应地形高程变化。为进一步提升探索效率并保持三维探索的通用性，我们在2.5D地图框架上进行二维路径规划，随后将其提升到三维，并在考虑地形可通行性的情况下评估视点之间的代价，从而减少频繁的高度变化并使探索更平滑。在仿真和真实环境中进行的大量实验证明了该方法相对于现有解决方案的有效性和优势。我们的方法在真实世界测试中实现了对超过2000 m²的杂乱森林和高程变化达10 m的倾斜山地地形进行快速探索，最高速度达到5 m/s。

items.title_en: BEV-Diffusion: Camera-Only Traversability Navigation with BEV Memory and Efficient Cross-Robot Adaptation
items.title_zh: BEV-Diffusion：具有BEV记忆和高效跨机器人适应的纯相机可通行性导航
items.abstract_en: Robot navigation requires both an understanding of the scene and an efficient adaptation to new robots, yet current methods rely on expensive LiDAR sensors, long mapping and modular pipelines. We present BEV-Diffusion, a camera-only model that learns a bird's-eye view (BEV) traversability map, its uncertainty and the path in a single network. A frozen DINOv2 backbone encodes consecutive RGB frames, which inverse perspective mapping and Bayesian fusion lift into the BEV, and a ranking loss keeps outdoor traversability graded rather than binary, separating asphalt from grass (median 0.94 vs. 0.75). On this map, a transformer denoiser generates polar waypoints in a few DDIM steps, and uncertainty-aware guidance refines the path and ends it where the map is no longer reliable. At deployment, a metric BEV memory keeps obstacles after they leave the camera view and warm starts each sample from the previous, ego-motion compensated path. Because the planner jointly learns the path, the map, and its uncertainty, it selects routes through terrain it can confidently traverse. In an unseen courtyard, a wheeled-legged robot autonomously traveled 120 m, completing 96% of the route without intervention, compared with 75-88% for the baselines. Even under low-light conditions after sunset, the proposed model completed the route without requiring any intervention. Retraining only the BEV head, about 3% of the parameters, adapts the model to a small legged robot in 2.3 min. Indoors, the memory gets this robot out of maze-like traps: it retains 62-66% of the nearby out-of-view obstacles, against at most 3% for the baselines, and the robot achieves 67-100% task progress, compared with 20-40% for the evaluated baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人导航既需要理解场景，也需要高效适应新机器人，然而当前方法依赖昂贵的LiDAR传感器、长时间建图和模块化流程。我们提出BEV-Diffusion，一种仅使用相机的模型，在单一网络中学习鸟瞰图（BEV）可通行性地图、其不确定性以及路径。冻结的DINOv2主干网络对连续RGB帧进行编码，逆透视映射和贝叶斯融合将其提升到BEV中，排序损失使室外可通行性保持分级而非二值，将沥青与草地分开（中位数0.94对0.75）。在该地图上，Transformer去噪器在少量DDIM步骤中生成极坐标路点，不确定性感知引导细化路径，并在地图不再可靠处终止路径。在部署时，度量BEV记忆在障碍物离开相机视野后仍保留它们，并用先前经自运动补偿的路径热启动每个样本。由于规划器联合学习路径、地图及其不确定性，它选择通过其能够自信穿越的地形的路线。在一个未见过的庭院中，轮腿机器人自主行驶了120 m，在无干预情况下完成了96%的路线，而基线为75-88%。即使在日落后低光照条件下，所提模型也无需任何干预即完成了路线。仅重新训练BEV头（约3%的参数），即可在2.3分钟内使模型适应小型足式机器人。在室内，该记忆使该机器人摆脱迷宫式陷阱：它保留了62-66%的附近视野外障碍物，而基线至多为3%，机器人达到67-100%的任务进度，而所评估基线为20-40%。

items.title_en: Navigating Robots from Unknown and Uncalibrated Exocentric Cameras via Map Estimation
items.title_zh: 通过地图估计从未知且未标定的外置相机导航机器人
items.abstract_en: Exocentric cameras, mounted on walls or ceilings in indoor environments, offer wider vantage points and are less easily occluded than robot-mounted cameras, making them an appealing alternative for perception in robot navigation algorithms. Previous methods that use such cameras, however, require their pose and intrinsics to be known before deployment, demanding calibration that is time-consuming, requires specialized personnel, and must be repeated whenever a camera moves or a new room is navigated. We propose Robot-centric Obstacle Maps from Unknown and uncalibrated eXocentric cameras (ROMUX), an agent that navigates a robot toward point goals while avoiding obstacles using exocentric cameras that are both uncalibrated, meaning the system does not require their pose or intrinsic information as input, and unknown, meaning it is not fit to a specific camera during training and does not require pre-deployment fine-tuning. We train a cross-view transformer on large-scale simulation data to predict metric robot-centric obstacle maps from exocentric images, without conditioning image tokens on camera information. A small policy trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) then navigates on the predicted maps toward a goal coordinate relative to the robot. We benchmark our agent in simulation with cameras randomized per episode, and it matches the success rates of a PPO policy that navigates from a robot-mounted camera. Further, ROMUX works with one camera or multiple cameras with partial views and has been transferred zero-shot to a real robot using a camera at varying positions and orientations across various room layouts.
items.abstract_zh: 安装在室内环境墙壁或天花板上的外置相机提供更宽的视角，且比机器人搭载相机更不易被遮挡，因此成为机器人导航算法中颇具吸引力的感知替代方案。然而，先前使用此类相机的方法要求部署前已知其位姿和内参，这需要耗时、需专业人员且每当相机移动或导航新房间时必须重复的标定。我们提出ROMUX（Robot-centric Obstacle Maps from Unknown and uncalibrated eXocentric cameras），一种智能体，利用既未标定（即系统不要求将其位姿或内参信息作为输入）又未知（即训练期间不针对特定相机拟合，且不需要部署前微调）的外置相机，引导机器人朝向点目标导航并避开障碍物。我们在大规模仿真数据上训练跨视图Transformer，从外置图像预测以机器人为中心的度量障碍物地图，而不将图像token以相机信息为条件。随后，一个用近端策略优化（PPO）训练的小型策略在预测地图上朝相对于机器人的目标坐标导航。我们在每个回合随机化相机的仿真中对该智能体进行基准测试，其成功率与从机器人搭载相机导航的PPO策略相匹配。此外，ROMUX可适用于一个相机或多个具有部分视图的相机，并已零样本迁移到真实机器人上，在不同房间布局中使用位置和方向变化的相机。

items.title_en: RESCUE Jumper: A Centimeter-Scale Rolling and Jumping Robot for Search and Rescue
items.title_zh: RESCUE Jumper：用于搜救的厘米级滚动与跳跃机器人
items.abstract_en: Centimeter-scale robots are promising for urban search and rescue because they can enter confined spaces that are inaccessible or unsafe for humans. However, their small size limits obstacle traversal after deployment. This paper presents the RESCUE Jumper, a 125 g mobile robot with a 6.2 cm width and 6.2 cm diameter wheels that combines ground rolling with jumping to traverse steps and gaps that exceeds its rolling capability. The RESCUE Jumper uses its two actuators for both rolling mode and jumping by reversing the direction of wheel motion. Forward wheel motion enables rolling, while reverse wheel motion winds a spring steel tail to store elastic potential energy and release it for jumping. The RESCUE Jumper varies tail winding speed to control jump direction, transitioning from backward to forward jumps as winding speed increases from 0.75 rad/s to 8.73 rad/s. The launch angle of the jumps ranges from 45 degree to -11 degree with respect to the vertical axis, reaching a maximum height of 9.2 cm and a maximum lateral displacement of 11.2 cm. We model the winding speed-dependent jumping behavior in three phases: tail release to determine the contact point and robot orientation, tail straightening until liftoff, and ballistic flight to predict jump height and lateral displacement. Finally, qualitative tests highlight the robot's locomotion in cluttered, real-world environments. The model and experiments presented in this work can inform future designs of space-constrained jump mechanisms in centimeter-scale robots for search and rescue and inspection in unstructured environments.
items.abstract_zh: 厘米级机器人有望用于城市搜救，因为它们可以进入人类无法到达或不安全的狭窄空间。然而，其小尺寸限制了部署后的越障能力。本文提出RESCUE Jumper，一种125 g的移动机器人，宽6.2 cm，轮径6.2 cm，结合地面滚动与跳跃，以穿越超出其滚动能力的台阶和间隙。RESCUE Jumper通过反转轮子运动方向，将两个执行器同时用于滚动模式和跳跃。轮子正向运动实现滚动，而反向运动卷绕弹簧钢尾以储存弹性势能并释放用于跳跃。RESCUE Jumper通过改变尾部卷绕速度来控制跳跃方向，随着卷绕速度从0.75 rad/s增加到8.73 rad/s，跳跃从向后跳转为向前跳。跳跃发射角相对于垂直轴的范围为45度至-11度，达到最大高度9.2 cm和最大横向位移11.2 cm。我们将依赖卷绕速度的跳跃行为建模为三个阶段：尾部释放以确定接触点和机器人姿态，尾部伸直直至离地，以及弹道飞行以预测跳跃高度和横向位移。最后，定性测试突出了该机器人在杂乱真实环境中的运动能力。本文提出的模型和实验可为未来用于非结构化环境中搜救和检查的厘米级机器人空间受限跳跃机构设计提供参考。

items.title_en: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
items.title_zh: 面向自主移动机器人的视觉-语言接地语义导航
items.abstract_en: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 语言引导导航使移动机器人能够解释自然语言命令，并在非结构化环境中朝用户指定目标导航。然而，将开放词汇视觉感知与用于建图和导航的经典机器人流水线集成仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。在这项工作中，我们提出一个完整的基于 ROS2 的系统，它结合基于前沿的探索、使用 Grounding DINO 的开放词汇目标检测、基于深度的三维定位和语义建图，以在仿真中实现端到端视觉-语言接地导航。该系统接受诸如“go to the yellow box”之类的自然语言命令，使用文本提示从 RGB 图像中检测候选对象，估计它们在世界坐标系中的位置，并生成由 Nav2 栈执行的导航目标。在配备 TurtleBot3 机器人的基于 Gazebo 的室内环境中，该系统自主探索了房间，检测到五个目标对象中的三个，并成功执行了所测试的两条自然语言导航命令，且无需任务特定训练。结果表明，开放词汇接地模型可以集成到经典导航流水线中，但性能受到检测不确定性、基于深度的定位误差和不完整探索覆盖的限制。这些发现凸显了使用轻量级、仅 CPU 架构部署视觉-语言接地导航系统的可行性与当前局限性。

items.title_en: Prediction-Error-Tightened MPC for Socially Compliant Crowd Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向社会合规人群导航的预测误差收紧MPC
items.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation of mobile robots in crowded environments, while preserving pedestrians' psychological comfort, requires distinguishing pedestrians from other obstacles, predicting their future motion, and accounting for uncertainty in the predicted trajectories of both pedestrians and the robot. This work extends a previous MPC framework by integrating obstacle and pedestrian detection, Koopman-based motion prediction, and online prediction-error estimation directly within the collision-avoidance mechanism. To reduce collision-avoidance complexity in crowded scenarios, nearby obstacles are aggregated, thereby reducing the number of collision-avoidance constraints. Simulation studies evaluate the prediction-error margins and the computational benefits of semantics-aware aggregation. In a paired 300-seed closed-loop comparison with a moving generic obstacle, Markov residual tightening reduces the fraction of runs with physical contact from $10.0\%$ to $1.33\%$, at a mean travel-time cost of $0.68$ s. In a separate crowd-navigation semantic ablation, the offline robot-footprint/personal-space overlap occupies $2.11\%$ of observed time with pedestrian-aware handling versus $22.84\%$ with generic-obstacle handling.
items.abstract_zh: 在拥挤环境中，移动机器人的自主导航同时需要保持行人的心理舒适性，这要求区分行人与其他障碍物、预测其未来运动，并考虑行人和机器人预测轨迹中的不确定性。本工作扩展了先前的MPC框架，将障碍物与行人检测、基于Koopman的运动预测以及在线预测误差估计直接集成到避碰机制中。为降低拥挤场景下的避碰复杂度，对邻近障碍物进行聚合，从而减少避碰约束的数量。仿真研究评估了预测误差裕度以及语义感知聚合的计算收益。在与移动的通用障碍物进行的配对300种子闭环比较中，Markov残差收紧将发生物理接触的运行比例从10.0%降低到1.33%，平均旅行时间代价为0.68 s。在单独的群体导航语义消融中，采用行人感知处理时，离线机器人足迹/个人空间重叠占观测时间的2.11%，而采用通用障碍物处理时为22.84%。

items.title_en: A Tightly Coupled Magnetic-Inertial SLAM System for Field Robots
items.title_zh: 面向野外机器人的紧耦合磁-惯性SLAM系统
items.abstract_en: Field robots operating in mines, tunnels, and disaster areas require reliable localization despite GNSS denial and degraded camera and LiDAR measurements caused by dust, smoke, or poor illumination. Missions involving both ground and aerial robots further motivate complementary sensing modalities that do not depend on visibility, preinstalled infrastructure, or wheel contact. This letter presents MISLAM, a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial simultaneous localization and mapping system using an IMU and a nine-magnetometer array, without relying on external odometry or platform-specific motion assumptions. The system combines the inertial navigation model with local polynomial magnetic-field models for short-term motion estimation and a global Gaussian process model for drift correction using an error-state Kalman filter. Offline evaluation on three indoor datasets collected with a handheld rig shows reductions in total endpoint closure error of 45.7% - 78.0% relative to magnetic-inertial odometry. Under poor illumination, MISLAM maintains tracking after visual-inertial odometry fails, achieving a horizontal closure error of 0.332 m, although vertical drift remains a limitation. These results support magnetic-inertial SLAM as a complementary localization modality for robotic sensor suites operating under degraded visual conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 在矿井、隧道和灾区作业的野外机器人，需要在GNSS拒止以及由粉尘、烟雾或光照不良导致的相机和LiDAR测量退化条件下仍具备可靠定位。同时涉及地面和空中机器人的任务进一步促使采用不依赖可见性、预装基础设施或车轮接触的互补传感模态。本文提出MISLAM，一种紧耦合磁-惯性同时定位与建图系统，使用IMU和九磁强计阵列，不依赖外部里程计或平台特定运动假设。该系统将惯性导航模型与用于短期运动估计的局部多项式磁场模型相结合，并使用误差状态卡尔曼滤波器结合全局高斯过程模型进行漂移校正。在三个使用手持装置采集的室内数据集上进行离线评估，结果显示总端点闭合误差相对于磁-惯性里程计降低45.7%–78.0%。在光照不良条件下，MISLAM在视觉-惯性里程计失效后仍保持跟踪，达到0.332 m的水平闭合误差，但垂直漂移仍是一个限制。这些结果支持将磁-惯性SLAM作为在视觉条件退化下运行的机器人传感器套件的补充定位模态。

items.title_en: Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion
items.title_zh: 空间条件轨迹扩散
items.abstract_en: Multi-Robot Motion Planning (MRMP) requires trajectories that avoid environmental obstacles and collisions between robots in a shared workspace. Diffusion-based planners often address obstacle avoidance through sampling-time guidance, while some conditioned approaches aggregate map geometry into a global representation. We present Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion (SCTD), a map-conditioned trajectory generator for multi-robot planning. SCTD retains multiple position-aware occupancy tokens accessed through cross-attention throughout a temporal U-Net, with hard endpoint inpainting enforcing start and goal states. One model trained on single-robot demonstrations across procedural environments generates obstacle-aware trajectories without sampling-time obstacle-cost guidance. High-level Conflict-Based Search (CBS) coordinates these trajectories through constrained replanning, retaining inter-agent guidance during sampling and reusing the model across workspace layouts and team sizes. Experiments assess single-robot success and trajectory quality, generalization to unfamiliar layouts with added obstacles, and coordinated multi-robot planning. On 15,000 held-out tasks, SCTD achieves higher success than the evaluated guided diffusion baseline, with the largest gains on hard-detour tasks, while trajectory-quality comparisons show smoother trajectories. Conditioning ablations show higher success with spatial tokens than with a global map embedding, and map-replacement tests demonstrate dependence on the supplied geometry. The resulting multi-robot system achieves higher team success than the compared diffusion baselines, with experiments covering teams of up to 15 robots.
items.abstract_zh: 多机器人运动规划（MRMP）需要轨迹避开环境障碍物以及共享工作空间中机器人之间的碰撞。基于扩散的规划器通常通过采样时引导来处理避障，而一些条件化方法将地图几何聚合为全局表示。我们提出空间条件轨迹扩散（SCTD），一种用于多机器人规划的地图条件轨迹生成器。SCTD 在整个时间 U-Net 中保留多个位置感知占用 token，并通过交叉注意力访问，同时使用硬端点修复强制起点和目标状态。一个在程序化环境中的单机器人演示上训练的模型，无需采样时障碍代价引导即可生成障碍物感知轨迹。高层冲突搜索（CBS）通过约束重规划协调这些轨迹，在采样期间保留智能体间引导，并在不同工作空间布局和团队规模间复用该模型。实验评估单机器人成功率和轨迹质量、对添加障碍物的陌生布局的泛化，以及协调多机器人规划。在 15,000 个留出任务上，SCTD 相比所评估的引导扩散基线取得更高成功率，在困难绕行任务上增益最大，同时轨迹质量比较显示轨迹更平滑。条件消融表明空间 token 比全局地图嵌入取得更高成功率，地图替换测试表明对所提供的几何的依赖。所得多机器人系统相比对比的扩散基线取得更高团队成功率，实验覆盖多达 15 个机器人的团队。

items.title_en: Recursive Bayesian Monitoring of SLAM Failures for LiDAR-Based UAV Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向激光雷达无人机导航的SLAM故障递归贝叶斯监测
items.abstract_en: SLAM failures remain difficult to avoid in autonomous robotic systems, and undetected failures can propagate to unsafe planning, control, and mission-level decisions. Existing monitoring strategies often depend on prior maps, estimator-internal variables, or redundant sensing, which limits their applicability to deployed and resource-constrained robots. This paper presents a scene-geometry consistency monitor for detecting geometry-manifested SLAM failures using only the geometric output of the SLAM backend. The targeted failures include cumulative drift-induced failures, abrupt misregistration failures, and backend map corruption when they become observable as inconsistency in reconstructed scene geometry. The proposed method represents revisited local regions with recursive latent voxel geometry and evaluates each current observation against a trusted continuation explanation and a weak non-propagated reference explanation. The resulting voxel-wise evidence contrasts are aggregated into a fixed-boundary monitoring signal for online failure declaration and downstream safety response. Experiments on self-collected sequences, GEODE benchmark sequences, multiple robotic platforms, and different SLAM backends show that the monitor responds to failures when they are manifested in backend scene geometry. It achieves 4/4 valid post-onset declarations with no pre-onset alarms on four self-collected sequences, detects geometry-manifested failures in all five corrupted GEODE runs while remaining alarm-free in five geometrically consistent runs, adds only 0.1--0.2\% absolute CPU load, and supports a closed-loop UAV detect--isolate--recover workflow.
items.abstract_zh: 在自主机器人系统中，SLAM故障仍难以避免，而未检测到的故障可能传播到不安全的规划、控制和任务级决策中。现有监测策略通常依赖先验地图、估计器内部变量或冗余传感，这限制了其在已部署且资源受限机器人上的适用性。本文提出一种场景几何一致性监测器，仅使用SLAM后端的几何输出检测以几何形式表现的SLAM故障。所针对的故障包括累积漂移导致的故障、突发配准错误故障，以及当后端地图损坏在重建场景几何中表现为不一致时的故障。所提方法使用递归潜在体素几何表示被重访的局部区域，并针对每个当前观测，与可信延续解释和弱非传播参考解释进行评估。得到的体素级证据对比被聚合为固定边界监测信号，用于在线故障声明和下游安全响应。在自采集序列、GEODE基准序列、多种机器人平台和不同SLAM后端上的实验表明，当故障在后端场景几何中表现出来时，监测器会作出响应。在四个自采集序列上，它实现了4/4次有效的故障发生后声明，且无故障发生前报警；在所有五个损坏的GEODE运行中检测到以几何形式表现的故障，同时在五个几何一致的运行中保持无报警；仅增加0.1–0.2%的绝对CPU负载；并支持闭环无人机检测—隔离—恢复工作流。

items.title_en: ECO-COMM: An Ultra Low-Latency Event Camera based Optical Communication System
items.title_zh: ECO-COMM：一种基于事件相机的超低时延光通信系统
items.abstract_en: Ultralow-latency communication is critical for emerging next-generation applications such as XR, real-time control, and distributed sensing. We present ECO-COMM, an event-camera-based optical communication system for ultra-low-latency device association and lightweight information exchange. By exploiting the asynchronous sensing and microsecond-level temporal resolution of event cameras, ECO-COMM captures high-frequency optical signals without frame-based acquisition delays. We identify and analyze key hardware-induced challenges in event-camera communication, including timestamp inconsistency, readout contention, trailing effects, and the inevitable refractory period, and develop hardware-aware mitigation techniques to address them. Focusing on a single transmitter-receiver optical link, ECO-COMM establishes the feasibility of practical ultra-low-latency event-camera communication using commercially available hardware.A prototype implementation using an eight-LED transmitter and an off-the-shelf event camera achieves device association within 15 microseconds, symbol latency as low as 100 microseconds, and end-to-end latency below 8 milliseconds for 32-byte payloads at 0.1% bit error rate. ECO-COMM establishes a practical and complementary communication paradigm for ultra-low-latency systems where responsiveness and temporal precision are paramount.
items.abstract_zh: 超低时延通信对XR、实时控制和分布式感知等新兴下一代应用至关重要。我们提出ECO-COMM，一种基于事件相机的光通信系统，用于超低时延的设备关联与轻量信息交换。利用事件相机的异步感知与微秒级时间分辨率，ECO-COMM无需基于帧的采集延迟即可捕获高频光信号。我们识别并分析了事件相机通信中若干关键的硬件诱发挑战，包括时间戳不一致、读出竞争、拖尾效应以及不可避免的不应期，并开发了硬件感知的缓解技术予以应对。聚焦单个发射机—接收机光链路，ECO-COMM验证了使用商用现成硬件实现实用超低时延事件相机通信的可行性。基于八个LED发射机与商用事件相机的原型实现，可在15微秒内完成设备关联，符号时延低至100微秒，并在0.1%误码率下实现32字节载荷低于8毫秒的端到端时延。ECO-COMM为以响应性和时间精度为优先的超低时延系统建立了一种实用且互补的通信范式。
items.highlight_zh: 用事件相机实现15微秒设备关联的超低时延光通信
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：XR、实时控制、分布式感知等应用对通信时延极其敏感，传统相机以固定帧率采集，天然带来帧周期等待，难以支撑微秒级的设备发现与轻量数据交换。

方法思路：作者提出 ECO-COMM，改用事件相机作为光接收端。事件相机不是逐帧曝光，而是每个像素在亮度变化时异步输出事件，因此具备微秒级时间分辨率，能直接捕捉高速闪烁的光信号，避免帧采集延迟。团队还系统梳理了这类方案中由硬件引入的四类难题：时间戳不一致、读出竞争、拖尾效应与不应期，并针对性地设计了硬件感知的补偿与调度技术。

实验结果：在单发射机—单接收机的链路原型上，使用八个 LED 组成的发射端与商用事件相机，系统可在 15 微秒内完成设备关联，符号时延低至 100 微秒；传输 32 字节载荷时，在 0.1% 误码率下端到端时延低于 8 毫秒。

为何重要：该工作证明仅用市面可得的硬件就能实现实用的超低时延光通信，并给出了一条与射频方案互补的技术路线。其价值在于把“感知式接收”引入通信领域，为对响应速度与时间精度要求极高的系统提供了新的设计范式，同时也为后续多链路、更高吞吐的研究标出了硬件瓶颈。

items.title_en: Confidently Lost: Silent Failure and Edge Deployment of Dense Visual SLAM under Photon Starvation
items.title_zh: 自信地迷失：光子饥饿下稠密视觉SLAM的静默失败与边缘部署
items.abstract_en: Dense visual SLAM built on learned two-view geometry is evaluated in good light; in low light it fails silently. Two frames of 9-level quantized noise, no scene at all, give MASt3R-SLAM's network a cross-view geometric self-consistency of 0.936; a real dark frame pair gives 0.935. Starved of structure, the network invents the same geometry for both views and the system trusts the agreement: on a dark sequence it consumes 1,605 frames, emits 7 keyframes, rejects no factor-graph edges and reports full frame rate, while over 95% of the correspondences it accepts violate the ground-truth epipolar geometry. One inflated statistic is read by two subsystems against thresholds in opposite directions, so keyframing starves while relocalization accepts almost every candidate. The same statistic, read at keyframe-pair baselines, separates the confident collapse from working runs on the ETH3D dark sequences without ground truth or extra computation (in-sample). Low-light-adapted weights take tracked trajectories from 1/6 to 5/6, as does retuning two thresholds; neither yields accurate ones, because the adaptation withdraws confidence from wrong geometry rather than finding right geometry. Replayed on a Jetson AGX Orin carried by a legged robot, the mechanism's signature reproduces on the two darkest of four routes, and which of its faces appears varies with route geometry and sensor encoding. The network does not lose confidence in the dark; it manufactures it.
items.abstract_zh: 基于学习到的双视图几何的稠密视觉SLAM通常在光照良好时评估；在低光下它会静默失败。两帧9级量化噪声、完全没有场景，使MASt3R-SLAM的网络获得0.936的跨视图几何自一致性；一对真实暗帧给出0.935。由于缺乏结构，网络为两个视图虚构出相同的几何，而系统信任这种一致性：在暗序列上，它处理1,605帧，输出7个关键帧，不拒绝任何因子图边，并报告满帧率，而其接受的对应中超过95%违反真值对极几何。一个被夸大的统计量被两个子系统以相反方向的阈值读取，导致关键帧化饥饿，而重定位几乎接受每个候选。同一统计量在关键帧对基线上读取时，无需真值或额外计算（样本内）即可将自信崩溃与ETH3D暗序列上的正常工作运行区分开。适应低光的权重将跟踪轨迹从1/6提升到5/6，重新调整两个阈值也有同样效果；两者都不能产生准确的轨迹，因为这种适应是从错误几何中撤回置信度，而不是找到正确几何。在由腿式机器人携带的Jetson AGX Orin上重放时，该机制的特征在四条路线中最暗的两条上重现，而其呈现哪一面随路线几何和传感器编码而变化。网络在黑暗中并未失去置信度；它制造了置信度。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation
items.title_en: ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation using Concept Vectors
items.title_zh: ConceptPose：使用概念向量的免训练零样本物体位姿估计
items.abstract_en: Object pose estimation is a fundamental task in computer vision and robotics, yet most methods require extensive, dataset-specific training. Concurrently, large-scale vision language models show remarkable zero-shot capabilities. In this work, we bridge these two worlds by introducing ConceptPose, a framework for object pose estimation that is both training-free and model-free. ConceptPose leverages a vision-language-model (VLM) to create open-vocabulary 3D concept maps, where each point is tagged with a concept vector derived from saliency maps. By establishing robust 3D-3D correspondences across concept maps, our approach allows precise estimation of 6DoF relative pose. Without any object or dataset-specific training, our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on common zero shot relative pose estimation benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by a relative 62% in average ADD(-S) score, including methods that utilize extensive dataset-specific training.
items.abstract_zh: 物体位姿估计是计算机视觉和机器人学的基础任务，但大多数方法需要大量数据集特定训练。同时，大规模视觉语言模型展现出显著的零样本能力。在本工作中，我们通过引入ConceptPose来连接这两个世界，这是一个既免训练又免模型的物体位姿估计框架。ConceptPose利用视觉语言模型（VLM）创建开放词汇3D概念图，其中每个点都标记有由显著图得到的概念向量。通过在概念图之间建立稳健的3D-3D对应关系，我们的方法可以精确估计6DoF相对位姿。无需任何针对物体或数据集的训练，我们的方法在常见的零样本相对位姿估计基准上取得最先进结果，平均ADD(-S)分数相对最强基线提升62%，包括使用大量数据集特定训练的方法。

items.title_en: Active Observation for Robust Visual Servoing in Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: 机器人操作中鲁棒视觉伺服的主动观察
items.abstract_en: Robust visual servoing during robotic grasping remains challenging, as approach-phase occlusion frequently disrupts closed-loop control. To address this, we present an active observation framework in which one arm of an existing dual-arm platform carries an RGB-D camera as an active observer while the other executes grasping. The observer repositions to maintain or recover a shared target-gripper view within the feasible shared-view workspace. Occlusion during the final approach is particularly acute: fixed eye-to-hand lacks an active recovery mechanism once the target is hidden, while eye-in-hand can suffer from self-occlusion and sensitivity to hand-eye calibration. The observer first uses an active two-phase viewpoint strategy to align high-precision RGB-D axes with task-relevant error components. If visibility later degrades, an occlusion-triggered exploration module pauses the worker arm and scores candidate viewpoints by observation quality to recover a shared target-gripper view. Because both objects are detected in a single RGB-D image, the resulting Relative Servo Error avoids differencing two independently transformed target and gripper estimates. We evaluate the system on a dual 6-DoF Piper platform using an open-vocabulary detector with text prompts, without task-specific fine-tuning or demonstrations. Across 50 randomized trials per object, the system achieves 94% grasp success versus 76% for a reactive viewpoint baseline and 64% for a fixed camera. On triggered severe-occlusion trials, recovery takes $1.8 \pm 0.6$ s on average.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人抓取过程中的鲁棒视觉伺服仍然具有挑战性，因为接近阶段的遮挡经常破坏闭环控制。为解决此问题，我们提出一个主动观察框架，其中现有双臂平台的一只手臂携带RGB-D相机作为主动观察者，而另一只执行抓取。观察者在可行的共享视野工作空间内重新定位，以维持或恢复目标-夹爪的共享视图。最终接近阶段的遮挡尤其严重：固定的眼在手外（eye-to-hand）一旦目标被隐藏就缺乏主动恢复机制，而眼在手上（eye-in-hand）可能遭受自遮挡和对相机手眼标定的敏感性。观察者首先使用主动两阶段视点策略，将高精度RGB-D轴与任务相关的误差分量对齐。如果之后可见性下降，遮挡触发的探索模块会暂停工作臂，并根据观察质量对候选视点评分，以恢复目标-夹爪的共享视图。由于两个物体在单张RGB-D图像中被检测，所得的相对伺服误差避免了对两个独立变换的目标和夹爪估计进行差分。我们在双6自由度Piper平台上使用带文本提示的开放词汇检测器评估系统，无需任务特定的微调或演示。对每个物体进行50次随机试验，系统达到94%的抓取成功率，而反应式视点基线为76%，固定相机为64%。在触发的严重遮挡试验中，恢复平均耗时$1.8 \pm 0.6$秒。
items.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Published in 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE), pp. 3026-3031

items.title_en: Spiking World-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: 用于机器人操作的脉冲世界-动作模型
items.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) predict how the world responds to actions and offer a promising path toward general embodied intelligence, but they are large and run the network many times per plan, so they are hard to deploy on robots. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) compute with sparse binary spikes and use additions instead of multiplications, which saves power. However, existing WAMs use dense videos as the world state, so a spiking version would spend most of its computation on the background. We therefore introduce SpikingWAM, the first spiking WAM, which uses a sparse task skeleton as the world state. Inspired by biological motor control, which attends only to the key positions of a task, the Task Skeleton State (TSS) keeps the keypoints of the arm and the task objects, and a small spiking front end estimates the object keypoints from images. Body Frame Spike Coding (BFSC) and Grid Coincidence Attention (GCA) keep millimetre precision, and the Persistent Single Step Readout (PSR) runs the network once per plan. On the simulated benchmarks LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0, SpikingWAM achieves competitive success rates with far less energy than ANN methods and surpasses all compared methods on LIBERO-Plus. Real robot experiments further confirm its effectiveness. These results show that a task skeleton lets spiking networks implement WAMs at very low energy, offering a new solution for low power embodied intelligence. Project page: https://wxqnl.github.io/spikingwam/
items.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）预测世界如何响应动作，为通用具身智能提供了一条有前景的路径，但它们规模大，且每次规划要运行网络多次，因此难以部署在机器人上。脉冲神经网络（SNN）使用稀疏二值脉冲进行计算，并使用加法而非乘法，从而节省功耗。然而，现有WAM使用稠密视频作为世界状态，因此脉冲版本会将大部分计算花在背景上。因此，我们提出SpikingWAM，首个脉冲WAM，它使用稀疏任务骨架作为世界状态。受生物运动控制仅关注任务关键位置的启发，任务骨架状态（TSS）保留手臂和任务物体的关键点，一个小型脉冲前端从图像中估计物体关键点。身体坐标系脉冲编码（BFSC）和网格重合注意力（GCA）保持毫米级精度，持久单步读出（PSR）每次规划只运行网络一次。在仿真基准LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上，SpikingWAM以远低于ANN方法的能量达到有竞争力的成功率，并在LIBERO-Plus上超过所有对比方法。真实机器人实验进一步证实了其有效性。这些结果表明，任务骨架使脉冲网络能够以极低能量实现WAM，为低功耗具身智能提供了一种新方案。项目页面：https://wxqnl.github.io/spikingwam/

items.title_en: Pressure Drop: Gravity Vector Estimation from a Distributed Barometric Pressure Sensor Array
items.title_zh: 压降：基于分布式气压传感器阵列的重力矢量估计
items.abstract_en: While gravity is often used in mobile robotics as a global constraint for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) algorithms, most estimation methods rely on indirect observation of the gravity vector. In this paper, we propose the use of altimeter measurements to directly observe the direction of the gravity vector. We provide a theoretical evaluation of the estimation noise and validate it through extensive experimental data, along with an evaluation of the impact of intersensor distance on our gravity vector estimates. Experimental results demonstrate that a median error of $0.87^\circ$ on the tilt estimation can be achieved with our system in semi-static scenarios. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential of this approach by comparing it with state-of-the-art methods based on Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs). We highlight that we achieve similar performance to that of IMU-based systems in highly dynamic scenarios and even outperform in specific cases of accelerometer measurement saturation. Finally, an additional experiment shows the potential use within a robotic system through the integration into an Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm.
items.abstract_zh: 在移动机器人中，重力常被用作同时定位与建图（SLAM）算法的全局约束，但大多数估计方法依赖对重力矢量的间接观测。本文提出利用高度计测量直接观测重力矢量的方向。我们给出估计噪声的理论评估，并通过大量实验数据进行验证，同时评估传感器间距对重力矢量估计的影响。实验结果表明，在半静态场景中，我们的系统可实现0.87°的中位倾斜估计误差。此外，我们通过与基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的最先进方法进行比较，展示了该方法的潜力。我们强调，在高动态场景中，我们达到与基于IMU的系统相似的性能，甚至在加速度计测量饱和的特定情况下表现更优。最后，另一项实验通过将方法集成到迭代最近点（ICP）算法中，展示了其在机器人系统内的潜在用途。
items.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027

items.title_en: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
items.title_zh: 通过残差学习分配改进多阶段任务的模仿策略
items.abstract_en: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. In stochastic point-mass docking experiments, most failures occurred in the final docking phase, whereas the largest completion gain occurred in the preceding channel phase; gain-based allocation improved completion over allocation proportional to failure counts and, in a variant with a longer approach, over uniform allocation at half of the budget. In simulated bimanual robotic assembly, the completion-gain estimates were positive only for insertion and release, although few failures occurred during release; in a second assembly configuration, a residual policy trained in the release phase improved completion from held-out states at the start of release by 16.9%.
items.abstract_zh: 残差强化学习使用有限的环境交互预算来校正经模仿训练的基础策略。在具有多个阶段的任务中，该预算必须在各阶段之间分配，而基础策略失败的阶段不一定是校正最能提高任务完成率的阶段。我们通过完成增益形式化这一区别：当在单个阶段中由状态反馈控制器替代基础策略动作的选定分量时，全任务完成概率的变化。我们将完成增益分解为到达该阶段的概率以及从该阶段开始时的条件完成改进，并从配对回合中估计它。正估计决定残差策略校正哪些动作分量以及训练回合如何跨阶段分布。在随机点质量对接实验中，大多数失败发生在最终对接阶段，而最大的完成增益出现在先前的通道阶段；基于增益的分配在完成率上优于按失败计数比例的分配，并且在具有更长接近过程的变体中，在半预算下优于均匀分配。在仿真双臂机器人装配中，完成增益估计仅对插入和释放为正，尽管释放期间发生的失败很少；在第二种装配配置中，在释放阶段训练的残差策略将从释放开始时的留出状态完成率提高了16.9%。
items.comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables

rm.usage: 把残差强化学习的环境交互预算按阶段完成增益分配，可借鉴到重装多阶段装配（接近—对位—插入—释放）中，只对基策略最薄弱的阶段做残差修正；但需先有装配仿真与基策略训练，不能直接解决科技核心标签位姿识别，落地成本高。

items.title_en: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
items.title_zh: 面向低功耗机器人自主性的能量感知开放词汇检测调度
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）使机器人能够搜索运行时目标查询，但固定频率推理会在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视角期间将嵌入式计算花费在低价值帧上。本文提出一种用于低功耗移动机器人的能量感知OVD调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度，在Jetson Orin Nano上的低、中、高功耗YOLO-World-S模式之间切换。我们在AgileX LIMO上使用40次真实导航试验评估能量-质量权衡：两个目标物体，每个目标-策略对五种放置，以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子试验中，调度器记录8/10任务成功，而每个固定频率基线为7/10，同时相对于8 Hz高频基线将Jetson平均输入功率（Jetson侧功耗指标）降低5.2%，并将实际OVD调用率降低34.0%。它并未最小化任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量，因为更长的任务可能抵消瞬时功率节省。单独的60 s静止微基准隔离感知工作负载：相对于8 Hz基线，调度器将平均功率从8.045 W降至7.301 W，能量从484.7 J降至438.1 J。这些结果支持机器人状态感知的OVD调度作为一种有前景的电源管理机制，并具有有竞争力的任务可靠性，同时表明任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量必须与任务进度和运行时间一起解读。
items.comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, accepted for publication in ICARCV 2026

items.title_en: An Open MuJoCo Simulation Framework for a Quadrotor Carrying a Tendon-Driven Soft Continuum Arm
items.title_zh: 用于搭载腱驱动软连续臂的四旋翼的开源 MuJoCo 仿真框架
items.abstract_en: Combining aerial robots with soft continuum manipulators promises safe, compliant interaction with the environment, but the coupled dynamics of a free-flying base and a highly deformable, underactuated arm are difficult to study without a suitable simulator. This paper describes an open-source simulation framework, built on the MuJoCo physics engine, for a quadrotor that carries a tendon-driven soft continuum arm underneath its body. The arm is modelled as a pseudo-rigid-body chain of twelve segments joined by pairs of orthogonal compliant hinges. Three tendons, spaced \SI{120}{\degree} apart and routed through every segment, bend it in any direction. A geometric tracking controller on $SE(3)$ flies the vehicle; its rotor allocation matrix is generated directly from the model description. A closed-form tendon-tension allocation keeps every tension within its limits and gives the same bending moment in every direction. We report the full set of modelling choices and parameters, and we evaluate the framework in four simulated scenarios: a \SI{36}{\second} mission with a figure-eight and a tendon-driven tip sweep, an attitude-gain study, a quasi-static characterization of the bending workspace, and an impulsive disturbance applied to the arm tip. With the nominal gains the vehicle tracks the mission with \SI{3.1}{\centi\meter} RMS position error while the arm tip swings up to \SI{37}{\centi\meter} from the body axis. The gain study shows that a low-bandwidth attitude loop lets the arm excite sustained oscillations. The simulation runs about $15\times$ faster than real time on a laptop CPU. All models, controllers and scripts that reproduce the figures are released.
items.abstract_zh: 将空中机器人与软连续操作器相结合，有望实现与环境安全、柔顺的交互，但如果没有合适的仿真器，自由飞行基座与高度可变形、欠驱动臂的耦合动力学难以研究。本文描述一个基于 MuJoCo 物理引擎的开源仿真框架，用于在机体下方搭载腱驱动软连续臂的四旋翼。该臂被建模为由十二个段组成的伪刚体链，各段通过成对的正交柔性铰链连接。三根腱彼此间隔 120°，并穿过每个段布置，可使其向任意方向弯曲。SE(3) 上的几何跟踪控制器控制飞行器；其旋翼分配矩阵直接由模型描述生成。闭式腱张力分配使每根腱的张力保持在其限制范围内，并在每个方向产生相同弯矩。我们报告完整的建模选择与参数，并在四个仿真场景中评估该框架：一个包含八字形运动和腱驱动末端扫掠的 36 秒任务、一项姿态增益研究、弯曲工作空间的准静态表征，以及施加于臂端的脉冲扰动。在标称增益下，飞行器以 3.1 厘米 RMS 位置误差跟踪任务，而臂端从机体轴摆动高达 37 厘米。增益研究表明，低带宽姿态环会让臂激发持续振荡。该仿真在笔记本电脑 CPU 上运行速度约为实时的 15 倍。所有可复现这些图表的模型、控制器和脚本均已发布。

items.title_en: C2Flight: A Closed-Loop Co-Simulation Framework for Early-Stage Evaluation of Heterogeneous UAV Computing Systems
items.title_zh: C2Flight：用于异构无人机计算系统早期评估的闭环协同仿真框架
items.abstract_en: Early-stage design of heterogeneous UAV computing systems requires evaluating how algorithm, hardware, communication, and system topology affect closed-loop flight before the complete system is available. However, design choices interact through the robotic feedback loop, making task performance difficult to predict from isolated component metrics, while existing execution-driven approaches postpone system-level design feedback until the computing system is integrated. This work presents C2Flight, a closed-loop co-simulation framework that represents target systems as parameterized dataflow graphs and integrates models of hardware under design with independently accessible physical hardware through a unified node interface. Its graph runtime captures the combined effects of buffering, activation, resource sharing, communication, and local timing on closed-loop flight behavior. Validation against onboard and wireless offboard physical computing pipelines confirms its timing fidelity and closed-loop prediction accuracy. Two case studies demonstrate early-stage exploration of deployment and accelerator bit-width choices. These results show that C2Flight exposes system-level design trade-offs before full-system integration, enabling rapid early-stage design refinement.
items.abstract_zh: 异构无人机计算系统的早期设计需要在完整系统可用之前评估算法、硬件、通信和系统拓扑如何影响闭环飞行。然而，设计选择通过机器人反馈回路相互作用，使得任务性能难以从孤立的组件指标预测，而现有的执行驱动方法将系统级设计反馈推迟到计算系统集成之后。本工作提出C2Flight，一个闭环协同仿真框架，将目标系统表示为参数化数据流图，并通过统一节点接口将设计中的硬件模型与可独立访问的物理硬件集成。其图运行时捕捉缓冲、激活、资源共享、通信和局部时序对闭环飞行行为的联合影响。与机载和无线离板物理计算流水线的验证确认了其时序保真度和闭环预测准确性。两个案例研究展示了对部署和加速器位宽选择的早期探索。这些结果表明，C2Flight在完整系统集成之前揭示系统级设计权衡，从而实现快速的早期设计细化。
