items.title_en: ECO-ID: Event-Camera based Optical System for Secure Multi-User Ultra-Low Latency Identification
items.title_zh: ECO-ID：基于事件相机的多用户超低时延安全光学识别系统
items.abstract_en: Time-critical interactive systems increasingly require ultra-low-latency device identification for multiple users, yet prevailing approaches such as passwords, QR codes, and RFID/NFC are constrained by human input, frame-based sensing, or near-contact range. This paper presents ECO-ID, an event-camera-based optical system for multi-user, ultra-low-latency identification over visible light communication (VLC). Leveraging microsecond-resolution, asynchronous observations of brightness transitions, ECO-ID employs a spatiotemporal coding design: disjoint LED subsets provide spatial separation among users, while user-specific timing delays encode identities without inter-user synchronization. The optical channel and event-driven sensing reduce full-scene capture relative to frame cameras and limit the RF attack surface, while enabling rapid token verification with freshness and replay protection. We implement a prototype and demonstrate that ECO-ID can practically achieve approximately 99.8\% localization and 98.7\% identification with 0.64 ms mean latency, while theoretically supporting identification at the scale of tens of concurrent users. Overall, ECO-ID provides a fast, privacy-conscious, and security-aware alternative for scalable multi-user identification in time-critical interactive environments.
items.abstract_zh: 时间敏感的交互系统日益需要面向多用户的超低时延设备识别，而密码、二维码、RFID/NFC等主流方式受限于人工输入、帧式传感或近距接触。本文提出ECO-ID，一种基于事件相机、通过可见光通信（VLC）实现多用户超低时延识别的光学系统。它利用事件相机对亮度跃变微秒级、异步的观测能力，采用时空编码设计：互不相交的LED子集在空间上区分不同用户，用户特定的时延则在不需用户间同步的情况下编码身份。光学信道与事件驱动传感减少了对整幅场景的采集，也缩小了射频攻击面，同时支持带新鲜性校验与重放保护的快速凭证验证。原型实验表明，ECO-ID 可实现约99.8%的定位率与98.7%的识别率，平均时延 0.64 ms，理论上可支持数十个并发用户。
items.highlight_zh: 事件相机+LED时空编码，实现0.64毫秒多用户光学身份识别
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：在需要即时响应的交互场景（如多人同时操作的大屏、AR/VR、门禁）中，设备要快速认出“现在是谁在操作”。密码要人输入、二维码要人举起来对准、RFID/NFC则要求贴近，且基于帧的摄像头天生有延迟。作者要解决的是：如何让多个用户几乎无感地、在毫秒级被识别出来。

二、用了什么方法：用事件相机作为接收器。事件相机不像普通摄像头那样逐帧曝光，而是只在像素亮度发生变化时异步输出事件，时间分辨率达微秒级。作者设计了时空联合编码：空间上，给不同用户分配互不重叠的LED子集，靠位置区分人；时间上，给每个用户设定专属的发光时延，靠“节奏”编码身份，而且不需要用户之间做时钟同步。安全方面，光信道不易被远程窃听，事件相机只记录变化而非整幅画面，也缩小了射频攻击面，并配合新鲜性校验与防重放机制。

三、有什么结果：作者做出原型系统，实测定位准确率约99.8%、身份识别准确率约98.7%，平均时延仅0.64 ms；分析表明该方案在原理上可扩展到数十个并发用户。

四、为何重要：它给出了一条不依赖人工操作、不依赖射频、且兼顾隐私与安全的识别路径，适用于对延迟极敏感的多人交互场景，是对二维码与RFID等方案的有力补充。

items.title_en: Channel Modeling and LED Spot Detection for Dense Image-Sensor Visible Light Communication
items.title_zh: 密集图像传感器可见光通信的信道建模与LED光斑检测
items.abstract_en: High-density LED arrays enable high-speed transmission in image-sensor-based visible-light communication (VLC) systems. However, when optical spots become blurred and spatially overlapped due to focal shift, resolution limitations, or interference, severe inter-symbol interference (ISI) occurs, significantly degrading decoding performance. Furthermore, radial distortion introduces geometric deformation of the LED grid, while vignetting leads to incomplete and asymmetric spot shapes at the periphery, both of which further hinder reliable signal detection. Existing methods mitigate ISI by reducing LED transmission signaling density. This paper proposes a robust decoding framework that maintains full LED signaling density. We introduce a pilot-aided geometric recognition method that uses a PSF-constrained Hough transform and circle-center alignment refinement. \textbf{In addition, radial distortion correction and vignetting-aware compensation are incorporated to restore geometric consistency and suppress edge-related detection errors.} By leveraging prior structural knowledge from pilot frames, the system effectively separates overlapping LED signals under severe optical distortion. Experimental results on a real-world VLC testbed confirm that the proposed method achieves superior decoding accuracy and throughput compared to conventional Hough-based and low-density baseline methods. The results highlight its potential for high-efficiency VLC applications in interference-prone environments.
items.abstract_zh: 高密度LED阵列可在基于图像传感器的可见光通信（VLC）系统中实现高速传输。但当离焦、分辨率受限或干扰导致光斑模糊并空间重叠时，会产生严重的符号间干扰（ISI），显著降低解码性能。此外，径向畸变使LED网格发生几何形变，渐晕则造成边缘光斑形状不完整且不对称，这些都进一步妨碍可靠检测。现有方法通过降低LED发送密度来缓解ISI。本文提出一种在保持全LED发送密度下仍能稳健解码的框架，引入基于导频的几何识别方法，采用受点扩散函数（PSF）约束的Hough变换与圆心对齐精修，并结合径向畸变校正与渐晕感知补偿，以恢复几何一致性、抑制边缘检测误差。借助导频帧提供的先验结构知识，系统可在严重光学畸变下分离重叠的LED信号。在真实VLC测试平台上的实验表明，该方法相较传统Hough类方法与低密度基线在解码准确率和吞吐量上均有优势。
items.highlight_zh: 保持全LED密度，用PSF约束Hough变换分离重叠光斑
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：用手机或工业相机拍摄LED阵列来做可见光通信时，LED越密、速率越高，但实际拍摄中光斑会因离焦、分辨率不足或相邻干扰而变糊、互相重叠，造成严重的符号间干扰（ISI）。同时镜头的径向畸变会把本来规整的LED网格“拉弯”，渐晕又让画面边缘的光斑变暗、残缺、不对称，这些都会让解码出错。以往的做法是少开一些LED（降低发送密度）来换取清晰度，代价是速率下降。

二、用了什么方法：作者坚持不降低LED密度，转而用“先验知识”来解题。系统先发送导频帧，让接收端知道LED阵列本应长什么样；再据此做几何识别——把光斑的形状特性（点扩散函数，PSF）作为约束嵌入Hough变换来检测圆斑，并用圆心对齐做亚像素级精修；同时估计并校正径向畸变、对渐晕做感知补偿，把边缘区域“拉回”正常形态。有了这些几何约束，即使光斑严重重叠也能被分离出来。

三、有什么结果：在真实VLC测试平台上，该方法的解码准确率和吞吐量都优于传统基于Hough变换的方法以及低密度发送的基线方案，说明“不牺牲密度也能可靠解码”是可行的。

四、为何重要：它把限制高速图像传感器VLC的瓶颈从“硬件光学缺陷”转化为“可利用的先验信息”，在干扰严重、镜头质量一般的现实环境中依然能跑高吞吐，为密集LED阵列VLC的实用化扫清了一大障碍。

items.title_en: Real-world Latency Analysis of Vehicular Visible Light Communication with Multiple LED Transmitters and an Event-Based Camera
items.title_zh: 多LED发射机与事件相机车联网可见光通信的真实场景时延分析
items.abstract_en: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution, low latency, and wide dynamic range, making them promising receivers for visible light communication (VLC) in vehicle-to-everything (V2X) applications. This work presents an event-camera-based VLC system addressing three key challenges: bandwidth saturation, multi-transmitter reception, and latency characterization. We adopt a positive-event-only mode and design a protocol that suppresses event generation while maintaining communication distance and a wide field of view. We also propose a method to identify multiple transmitters and demonstrate simultaneous reception from up to three LEDs. Finally, we evaluate end-to-end latency in real vehicular scenarios and show that the system meets cooperative perception requirements. These results demonstrate that event-camera-based VLC is a feasible complement to existing V2X technologies (e.g., RF).
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机具备高时间分辨率、低时延和宽动态范围，是车联网（V2X）中可见光通信（VLC）颇具前景的接收器。本文提出一种基于事件相机的VLC系统，应对带宽饱和、多发射机接收与时延刻画三大挑战。作者采用仅正事件模式，并设计协议以抑制事件产生，同时保持通信距离与宽视场；提出多发射机识别方法，演示了最多三盏LED的同时接收；最后在真实车辆场景中评估端到端时延，表明系统满足协同感知的需求。结果说明基于事件相机的VLC可作为现有V2X技术（如射频）的可行补充。
items.highlight_zh: 事件相机车联网VLC实测端到端时延，可支持三灯同时接收
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：车与车、车与路之间的通信（V2X）目前主要靠射频，但射频在拥堵信道和高密度场景下会受限。可见光通信可作为补充——车灯本来就在发光。问题是：普通相机帧率太低、延迟太大；而事件相机虽然响应极快（微秒级）、动态范围宽，用在车上却有三个实际障碍：事件输出速率太高会把带宽“撑爆”；一辆车视野里往往有多盏灯同时发送，怎么区分；以及在真实道路条件下端到端到底有多快，此前不清楚。

二、用了什么方法：作者采用“只取正事件”的工作模式（只响应变亮），并设计了一套协议主动抑制事件产生量，从而在保住通信距离和大视场的前提下避免数据洪流。针对多发射机，提出用空间位置区分不同LED的方法，实现最多三盏LED同时接收。最后搭建真实车载场景，测量从发到收的端到端时延。

三、有什么结果：系统能够同时接收三盏LED的信号，且端到端时延满足协同感知（车辆间共享感知数据）的实时性要求，证明该方案在真实车辆场景中可用。

四、为何重要：它把事件相机VLC从实验室演示推进到真实车辆场景，系统性地回答了“带宽够不够、多灯能不能分、快不快”这三个决定能否落地的关键问题，说明光通信可以成为射频V2X的实用补充。

items.title_en: An Open-Source Research Platform for Embedded Visible Light Networking
items.abstract_en: Despite the growing interest in Visible Light Communication (VLC), a reference networking platform based on commercial off-the-shelf components is not available yet. An open-source platform would lower the barriers to entry to VLC network research and help the VLC community gain momentum. We introduce OpenVLC, an open-source VLC research platform based on software-defined implementation. Built around a credit-card-sized embedded Linux platform with a simple opto-electronic transceiver front-end, OpenVLC offers a basic physical layer, a set of essential medium access primitives, as well as interoperability with Internet protocols. We investigate the performance of OpenVLC and show examples of how it can be used along with standard network diagnostics tools. Our software-defined implementation can currently reach throughput in the order of the basic rate of IEEE 802.15.7 standard. We discuss several techniques that researchers and engineers could introduce to improve the performance of OpenVLC and envision several directions that can benefit from OpenVLC by adopting it as a reference platform.
items.title_zh: 一个面向嵌入式可见光网络的的开源研究平台
items.abstract_zh: 尽管可见光通信（VLC）受到越来越多的关注，但基于商用现成组件的参考网络平台仍未出现。一个开源平台将降低VLC网络研究的入门门槛，并有助于VLC社区形成声势。我们推出OpenVLC——一个基于软件定义实现的开源VLC研究平台。OpenVLC围绕信用卡大小的嵌入式Linux平台构建，配有简单的光电收发前端，提供基础物理层、一组必要的介质访问原语，以及与互联网协议的互操作性。我们考察了OpenVLC的性能，并展示其如何与标准网络诊断工具配合使用的示例。我们的软件定义实现目前可达到与IEEE 802.15.7标准基本速率相当量级的吞吐量。我们讨论了研究人员与工程师可用于提升OpenVLC性能的若干技术，并展望了采用它作为参考平台而受益的多个方向。
items.highlight_zh: 推出开源软件定义可见光通信研究平台OpenVLC
items.digest_zh:
本研究要解决的问题是：可见光通信（VLC）研究热度上升，但社区缺少一个基于商用现成器件、可复现的参考网络平台，导致入门门槛高、各家实验难以对比。

作者的做法是构建 OpenVLC：硬件上采用信用卡大小的嵌入式 Linux 单板计算机，外接一个简单的光电收发前端；软件上采用软件定义的方式，自行实现基础物理层、若干必要的介质访问控制原语，并让系统能够与标准互联网协议互通，从而把 VLC 链路接入常规网络栈。

在结果方面，作者测量了 OpenVLC 的实际性能，并用标准网络诊断工具做了演示性实验，说明该平台可直接沿用现有网络调试方法；当前吞吐量达到 IEEE 802.15.7 标准基本速率的量级，属于可用但仍有提升空间的原型水平。文中还讨论了研究者可采用的若干性能改进手段。

其重要性在于：开源与低成本降低了 VLC 组网研究的门槛，使更多团队能复现与比较实验结果，有助于该领域形成共同基准；同时软件定义的架构便于快速试验新协议与新算法。它为可见光通信从点对点链路走向真正的网络化研究提供了可共享的起点。

items.title_en: Seeing Together, Acting Apart: Shared Environmental Understanding for Multi-Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 共同感知、分开行动：面向多机器人导航的共享环境理解
items.abstract_en: Multi-robot embodied systems are typically designed to collaborate by coordinating actions, sharing trajectories, or learning joint policies. We ask a complementary question: can collaboration emerge before decision-making, by first building a shared understanding of the environment? We introduce Shared Environmental Understanding, a policy-agnostic representation that aggregates partial egocentric observations from multiple robots into a shared latent world model. This shifts collaboration from the policy space to the representation space, enabling decentralized decision-making with shared environmental context. To this end, we propose Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval (SEER), a framework that organizes multi-robot observations into a shared memory, retrieves relevant context via spatio-temporal similarity, and encodes it using a predictive latent world model. The resulting representations are injected into downstream navigation agents as tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that SEER captures action-relevant environmental structure and consistently improves navigation performance across both specialized VLN agents and general vision-language model agents, while preserving single-agent capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 多机器人具身系统通常通过协调动作、共享轨迹或学习联合策略来设计协作。我们提出一个互补的问题：协作能否在决策之前涌现，即先建立对环境的共享理解？我们引入共享环境理解（Shared Environmental Understanding），这是一种策略无关的表示，将来自多个机器人的部分自中心观测聚合为共享潜世界模型。这将协作从策略空间转移到表示空间，使得在共享环境上下文下进行去中心化决策成为可能。为此，我们提出共享环境编码与检索（Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval, SEER）框架，该框架将多机器人观测组织为共享记忆，通过时空相似性检索相关上下文，并使用预测性潜世界模型对其进行编码。所得表示作为令牌注入下游导航智能体。实验结果表明，SEER能够捕捉与动作相关的环境结构，并在专用VLN智能体和通用视觉语言模型智能体上持续提升导航性能，同时保持单智能体能力。

items.title_en: GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation
items.title_zh: GeLiFiSH：结合地面与运动物体分割的递归LiDAR关键点估计
items.abstract_en: LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR配准和回环检测通常依赖稀疏关键点，这些关键点必须在不同会话、视角和传感器之间保持可重复性。为处理不同的扫描模式，检测器通常作用于累积子图，这会引入延迟，并且独立处理每个子图，因此重复观测从未被融合。基于高度的检测器还将结构参照于估计地面，因此其跨会话的不一致性会传播到关键点中。此外，动态物体会留下鬼影轨迹，可能被误认为静态结构。我们提出GeLiFiSH（Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing），一种无学习滤波器，以扫描速率递归估计持久关键点。高度结构检测器在滚动体素地图上运行，检测结果以位置、协方差和存在概率初始化轨迹，并通过序贯概率比检验进行接受或拒绝。地面分割提供传感器无关的高度参考，运动物体分割在插入地图前移除动态点。在SemanticKITTI、HeLiMOS和HeLiPR上，跨越五个LiDAR和多个会话，GeLiFiSH在比较的检测器中获得最高的平均关键点可重复性，并且仅从关键点获得的跨会话配准召回率排名第二，仅次于提取关键点多四倍的ISS。使用一组参数且无传感器高度先验时，地面分割和运动物体分割模块平均均优于其基线。

items.title_en: GravHMR: Coupling SLAM and Human Mesh Recovery in a Shared Gravity Frame
items.title_zh: GravHMR：在共享重力坐标系中耦合SLAM与人体网格恢复
items.abstract_en: Recovering globally consistent 3D human motion from monocular videos remains challenging under dynamic camera motion. Although SLAM and human mesh recovery (HMR) provide complementary camera and body estimates, directly combining them often leads to inconsistent orientations and accumulated trajectory drift. We present GravHMR, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples SLAM and HMR through a shared gravity-aligned reference. By allowing gravity to be estimated independently of the HMR backbone, GravHMR accommodates world-grounded HMR models with or without explicit gravity-view representations. Specifically, Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization (YAOO) resolves heading inconsistencies by correcting body and velocity orientations about the shared gravity axis. Conditioned on these corrected orientations, Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization (GATO) anchors root trajectories in the metric SLAM world by jointly leveraging 2D reprojection, the metric scale implicit in the human body, and the body's own motion. On EMDB-2, GravHMR achieves state-of-the-art performance with 154.0 mm W-MPJPE100 using ViPE and 189.8 mm using masked DROID-SLAM, outperforming TRAM (222.4 mm) under the same masked DROID-SLAM camera estimates. It further reduces W-MPJPE100 by 44.3% over GVHMR (276.5 mm) and by 20.0% over GVHMR + HTD-Refine (192.4 mm) with the same HMR backbone.
items.abstract_zh: 在动态相机运动下，从单目视频恢复全局一致的3D人体运动仍然具有挑战性。尽管SLAM和人体网格恢复（HMR）提供互补的相机和身体估计，直接组合它们通常会导致方向不一致和轨迹漂移累积。我们提出GravHMR，一种无需训练、即插即用的框架，通过共享的重力对齐参考耦合SLAM和HMR。通过允许重力独立于HMR主干进行估计，GravHMR可适配带有或不带有显式重力视角表示的世界接地HMR模型。具体而言，偏航感知方向优化（YAOO）通过围绕共享重力轴校正身体和速度方向来解决航向不一致。以这些校正后的方向为条件，重力感知轨迹优化（GATO）通过联合利用2D重投影、人体中隐含的度量尺度以及身体自身运动，将根轨迹锚定在度量SLAM世界中。在EMDB-2上，GravHMR使用ViPE达到154.0 mm W-MPJPE100，使用masked DROID-SLAM达到189.8 mm，取得最先进性能，在相同masked DROID-SLAM相机估计下优于TRAM（222.4 mm）。在相同HMR主干下，它进一步将W-MPJPE100较GVHMR（276.5 mm）降低44.3%，较GVHMR + HTD-Refine（192.4 mm）降低20.0%。

items.title_en: RoboCap-10k: A Metrically Accurate Egocentric Dataset for Robot Learning
items.title_zh: RoboCap-10k：用于机器人学习的度量精确第一人称数据集
items.abstract_en: Egocentric video is the most scalable source of manipulation data for robot learning, but its difficulty lies in producing high-quality supervision. Existing large corpora lack metric 3D labels or rely on heterogeneous devices, motion-capture labs, or a headset's built-in real-time tracker, whose accuracy is not reported for the released data. We introduce RoboCap-10k: 10,000 curated hours of unscripted manipulation recorded during workers' paid shifts in 11 countries, spanning 18 task families, 200 task types, and 2,000 tasks. Every hour is captured on one device, the RoboCap, a 250 g hat with six synchronized global-shutter cameras and dual IMUs. Online calibration brings every device below 1 px of epipolar error, visual-inertial SLAM yields gravity-aligned 6-DoF head trajectories, and a multi-view hand tracker yields metric cm-precise hand poses. Each episode is annotated with task and sub-task language captions. Project page: https://robocap10k.com
items.abstract_zh: 第一人称视频是机器人学习中最具可扩展性的操作数据来源，但其难点在于生成高质量监督。现有大型语料库缺乏度量三维标签，或依赖异构设备、动作捕捉实验室或头显内置实时跟踪器，且未报告发布数据的精度。我们推出RoboCap-10k：在11个国家工人带薪轮班期间录制的10,000个精选小时的无脚本操作数据，涵盖18个任务族、200种任务类型和2,000项任务。每个小时的数据均由同一设备RoboCap采集，该设备是一顶重250克的帽子，配备六个同步全局快门相机和双IMU。在线标定使每台设备的对极误差低于1像素，视觉惯性SLAM生成重力对齐的6自由度头部轨迹，多视角手部跟踪器生成具有厘米级度量精度的手部姿态。每个片段都标注了任务和子任务的语言描述。项目页面：https://robocap10k.com

items.title_en: Beyond Easy Clients: Difficulty- and Improvement-Aware Aggregation for Federated Reinforcement Learning in Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 超越简单客户端：面向机器人导航中联邦强化学习的难度与改进感知聚合
items.abstract_en: Federated reinforcement learning enables a fleet of robots to jointly learn a shared navigation policy without exchanging raw experience. In practice, however, the robots rarely operate in the same conditions: an open aisle is far easier to navigate than a cluttered room, and takes less learning to master. Standard federated aggregation rules ignore this. Uniform averaging weights every client equally, whether or not it is still learning, and weighting by episode return is worse, since easy environments permit high returns by construction. Both failures stem from what we call the \emph{plateau problem}: once a client masters its environment, its updates carry little new information even though its reported return remains high. We propose \emph{FedDIA}, which scores each client by how much its local training improves the global model it received, amplified by the difficulty of its environment. Difficulty is inferred from the model's own performance, without requiring any description of the environment. Both signals are measured against the global model, so they are comparable across clients. On a mapless navigation task with eight heterogeneous clients, FedDIA reaches a mean success rate of $75.5\%$ across training and held-out environments, against $68.7\%$ for the strongest federated baseline. Its advantage holds when the models are transferred to hand-authored warehouse and living-space layouts, or when one of the clients is defective.
items.abstract_zh: 联邦强化学习使一组机器人能够联合学习共享导航策略，而无需交换原始经验。然而在实践中，机器人很少在相同条件下运行：开放过道比杂乱房间更容易导航，并且掌握所需的学习更少。标准联邦聚合规则忽略了这一点。均匀平均对每个客户端等权，无论其是否仍在学习；而按回合回报加权更糟，因为简单环境在构造上就允许高回报。这两种失败都源于我们所说的平台期问题：一旦客户端掌握了其环境，即使其报告的回报仍然很高，其更新也几乎不携带新信息。我们提出FedDIA，它根据每个客户端的本地训练对其收到的全局模型的改进程度进行评分，并由其环境的难度放大。难度从模型自身的性能推断，无需任何环境描述。两个信号均针对全局模型测量，因此可在客户端之间比较。在具有八个异构客户端的无地图导航任务上，FedDIA在训练和留出环境中达到75.5%的平均成功率，而最强的联邦基线为68.7%。当模型迁移到手工编写的仓库和居住空间布局时，或当其中一个客户端存在缺陷时，其优势仍然保持。
items.comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables

items.title_en: How Uncertain Is My Action? Self-Correcting Visual Planning with Frozen World Models
items.title_zh: 我的动作有多不确定？使用冻结世界模型的自校正视觉规划
items.abstract_en: A frozen latent world model combined with sampling-based model predictive control is a visual planner. At deployment, the executed action can depart from the commanded one, and the frozen model has no way to notice. We show that the model can be run in reverse: for any hypothesized actuation shift, it predicts what it should have observed under that shift, and comparing this prediction with what was actually observed quantifies the shift and lets the planner correct itself. Unlike the residual energy, which mixes the shift with the model's own error, the score keeps only the part of the residual that a shift can produce. This shift score detects the shift with a locally optimal test, estimates it with Cramer-Rao error bars, names the dominant generator, and compensates the planner once an alarm fires. On PushT, TwoRoom and OGBench-Cube with a frozen latent world model, measured detection follows the prediction to within 0.05 AUROC. Self-correction raises success from 0.650 to 0.862 on PushT and from 0.378 to 0.432 on the harder Cube task, levels with an oracle that is told the true shift at the same block, better than five common test-time adaptation methods. On a real robotic arm, the score identifies a base-joint offset that no joint encoder registers and reduces the reach error from 36 mm to 3-5 mm, and under shifts drawn at random and sealed before the session, estimates recover 92-94% of the error reduction achieved with the true shift. The broader implication is that a frozen world model can act as a filter by predicting the future, testing action-interface uncertainty and validity, and finally correcting failures.
items.abstract_zh: 冻结的潜世界模型与基于采样的模型预测控制相结合构成视觉规划器。在部署时，执行动作可能偏离指令动作，而冻结模型无法察觉。我们表明该模型可以反向运行：对于任何假设的执行偏移，它预测在该偏移下本应观察到的内容，并将该预测与实际观察到的内容进行比较，从而量化该偏移并使规划器自我校正。与将偏移与模型自身误差混合的残差能量不同，该评分仅保留偏移可能产生的那部分残差。该偏移评分使用局部最优检验检测偏移，用Cramer-Rao误差条估计偏移，识别主导生成源，并在警报触发后补偿规划器。在使用冻结潜世界模型的PushT、TwoRoom和OGBench-Cube上，实测检测结果与预测的偏差在0.05 AUROC以内。自校正将PushT上的成功率从0.650提高到0.862，在更难的Cube任务上从0.378提高到0.432，与在同一区块被告知真实偏移的oracle持平，优于五种常见的测试时自适应方法。在真实机械臂上，该评分识别出没有关节编码器记录的基座关节偏移，并将到达误差从36 mm降低到3-5 mm；在会话前密封并随机抽取的偏移下，估计值恢复了使用真实偏移所实现误差降低的92-94%。更广泛的含义是，冻结世界模型可以通过预测未来、检验动作接口的不确定性和有效性，并最终校正失败，从而充当滤波器。

rm.usage: 冻结世界模型＋MPC的规划自校正可用于仿真中做执行偏差检测，但面向机械臂推物任务，与自瞄、导航、装配的实际控制链路差距较大，关联弱。

items.title_en: Visual-Inertial RGB-D SLAM with Encoders for a Differential Wheeled Robot
items.title_zh: 面向差速轮式机器人的带编码器视觉-惯性RGB-D SLAM
items.abstract_en: Recent years have seen multiple impressive results in visual-inertial odometry (VIO) techniques, by which accurate state estimation can be achieved via the extended Kalman filter (EKF) or nonlinear optimization. However, these approaches are rarely open source, and they tend to fail in real experiments due to the temporary lack of feature points and fast motion. Therefore, in this study, we used encoders to overcome the temporary failure of purely vision-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Here, we propose a generative measurement model for encoders and derive an expression for the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate and necessary Jacobians for optimization. We use our theory to present a novel tightly coupled visual-inertial encoder RGB-Depth (RGB-D) SLAM system. Tests on our system on an in-house dataset confirmed that our modeling effort led to accurate (with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of approximately 2-7 cm) and robust state estimation in real time. The source code and our dataset containing the encoder information have been published for verification.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）技术取得了多项令人印象深刻的成果，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）或非线性优化可实现准确的状态估计。然而，这些方法很少开源，并且由于特征点暂时缺失和快速运动，往往在真实实验中失败。因此，在本研究中，我们使用编码器来克服纯视觉同时定位与建图（SLAM）的暂时失效。我们提出编码器的生成式测量模型，并推导最大后验（MAP）估计表达式以及优化所需的雅可比矩阵。我们利用该理论提出一种新颖的紧耦合视觉-惯性-编码器RGB-Depth（RGB-D）SLAM系统。在自建数据集上对我们系统的测试证实，我们的建模工作实现了实时、准确（均方根误差（RMSE）约为2–7 cm）且稳健的状态估计。源代码和包含编码器信息的数据集已发布以供验证。
items.comment: 11 pages. Author-accepted manuscript of the article published in IEEE Sensors Journal, 2022

rm.usage: 把轮式编码器作为紧耦合测量引入VIO，可在特征点缺失或快速机动时维持状态估计，正好对应哨兵底盘在战场内自主定位的鲁棒性改造；需把差速模型换成实际底盘模型并重标定。

items.title_en: Capability-Conditioned Graph Control Barrier Functions for Zero-Shot Safe Navigation of Heterogeneous Mobile Robot Teams
items.title_zh: 用于异构移动机器人团队零样本安全导航的能力条件化图控制屏障函数
items.abstract_en: Multi-robot systems are increasingly deployed as heterogeneous fleets with diverse kinematic and actuation capabilities. While graph control barrier function (GCBF) methods provide a scalable framework for decentralized safe control, existing approaches typically assume homogeneous robot dynamics. Methods that directly encode robot classes can distinguish known types, but do not represent state-dependent motion capabilities or naturally transfer to unseen robot models. To address this challenge, we propose the Capability-Conditioned Heterogeneous Graph Control Barrier Function (CC-HGCBF), defined in a shared second-order reference-point operational space. This formulation provides a common geometric representation of safety across heterogeneous robots while retaining their model-specific dynamics and admissible control constraints. To enable zero-shot transfer, we introduce the Radial Capability Field (RCF), a compact, fixed-dimensional representation of each robot's state-dependent finite-horizon reachable velocity set. Conditioning the shared graph barrier and decentralized policy on the RCF enables them to adapt to changes in robot state, kinematic constraints, and control limits without relying on predefined robot identities. We jointly train the barrier and policy using proactive safety labeling and neural CBF-QP supervision, and evaluate them on mixed teams containing both seen and unseen robot models. Experiments demonstrate scalable safe coordination and zero-shot transfer to robot models and capability variations withheld during training. Physical-robot experiments further demonstrate zero-shot deployment to unseen kinematic models without retraining.
items.abstract_zh: 多机器人系统正越来越多地以具有多样运动学与驱动能力的异构车队形式部署。尽管图控制屏障函数（GCBF）方法为分散式安全控制提供了可扩展框架，但现有方法通常假设机器人动力学同质。直接编码机器人类别的方法能够区分已知类型，但不能表示状态相关的运动能力，也不能自然迁移到未见过的机器人模型。为应对这一挑战，我们提出能力条件化异构图控制屏障函数（CC-HGCBF），其定义在共享的二阶参考点操作空间中。该形式化为异构机器人提供了一种共同的安全几何表示，同时保留其模型特定的动力学和容许控制约束。为实现零样本迁移，我们引入径向能力场（RCF），这是对每个机器人状态相关的有限时域可达速度集的紧凑、固定维表示。将共享图屏障和分散式策略以RCF为条件，使其能够适应机器人状态、运动学约束和控制限制的变化，而无需依赖预定义的机器人身份。我们使用主动安全标注和神经CBF-QP监督联合训练屏障与策略，并在包含已见和未见机器人模型的混合团队上进行评估。实验展示了可扩展的安全协调，以及对训练期间保留的机器人模型和能力变化的零样本迁移。物理机器人实验进一步展示了无需重新训练即可零样本部署到未见的运动学模型。
items.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables

items.title_en: Learning Direct Control from Optimization for Dynamic Target Tracking
items.title_zh: 从优化中学习直接控制以实现动态目标跟踪
items.abstract_en: Dynamic target tracking requires a mobile robot to maintain target visibility while navigating obstacles with smooth, feasible controls. Online trajectory optimization explicitly encodes these objectives but requires repeated numerical solving, whereas waypoint-based neural policies separate geometric prediction from control execution. We introduce LECO, a framework that transfers tracking optimization into offline learning of a direct-control policy. LECO predicts control sequences and maps them to trajectories through a differentiable kinematic model, allowing trajectory-level objectives to directly guide control learning. A decaying expert-guidance curriculum initializes effective tracking behavior and progressively shifts learning toward these task objectives. At deployment, a predictive safety lock checks short-horizon obstacle clearance and invokes a classical planning and control fallback when the predicted motion is unsafe or the target prediction is invalid. Across three simulated obstacle densities, LECO reduces root-mean-square linear jerk by 14.1--31.2\% relative to the best competing method for this metric and achieves the highest tracking success rate, with per-cycle computation times of 4.25--5.63\,ms. Experiments on two robot platforms further demonstrate tracking through indoor narrow passages and outdoor forest environments. These results demonstrate that learning direct control from optimization enables smooth and robust dynamic target tracking.
items.abstract_zh: 动态目标跟踪要求移动机器人在导航避障的同时保持目标可见，并以平滑、可行的控制运行。在线轨迹优化显式编码这些目标，但需要反复进行数值求解；而基于路点的神经策略将几何预测与控制执行分离。我们提出LECO，一个将跟踪优化转化为直接控制策略离线学习的框架。LECO预测控制序列，并通过可微分运动学模型将其映射为轨迹，从而使轨迹级目标能够直接指导控制学习。衰减式专家引导课程初始化有效的跟踪行为，并逐步将学习转向这些任务目标。在部署时，预测性安全锁检查短时域障碍物间隙，并在预测运动不安全或目标预测无效时调用经典规划与控制回退。在三种仿真障碍物密度下，LECO相对于该指标上最佳竞争方法将均方根线性加加速度降低14.1--31.2%，并取得最高跟踪成功率，每周期计算时间为4.25--5.63 ms。在两个机器人平台上的实验进一步展示了在室内狭窄通道和室外森林环境中的跟踪。这些结果表明，从优化中学习直接控制能够实现平滑且鲁棒的动态目标跟踪。

rm.usage: 动态目标跟踪与避障的直接控制策略可借鉴到哨兵移动中保持对敌方目标的跟踪，以及云台随动时的短时预测与安全回退；但论文不涉及装甲板识别、弹道预测与射击闭环，需改造。

items.title_en: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: DexLatentWorld：用于零样本机器人操作的3D跨具身潜动作世界模型
items.abstract_en: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM's reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型通过使智能体能够预见其动作后果，促进机器人操作中的规划与控制。然而，它们通常依赖带动作标签的交互数据，这类数据获取成本高且难以扩展。这些模型也常常绑定于训练时特定具身，限制了向先前未见机器人形态的迁移。我们引入一种3D潜动作世界模型，直接从重定向人类操作演示的点云观测中学习连续动作表示。使用对比目标鼓励跨具身的一致运动表示。所得统一潜动作空间直接作为模型预测控制的搜索空间，其中采样的潜动作条件化基于粒子的未来预测。随后从预测的几何运动中恢复可执行机器人命令，而无需具身特定动作解码器。通过广泛评估，我们证明学习到的潜动作表现出可控且可组合的运动，迁移到未见机器人具身，并支持具有未见夹爪几何的零样本操作。经过任务无关适应后，我们的模型在到达、抓取和放置上分别达到90%、92%和60%的成功率，而DexWM报告分别为72%、58%和28%。最后，我们展示使用未见灵巧手的零样本真实世界操作，在涉及推动、抓取和举升日常物体的五个多样任务上，50次试验中达到86%的成功率。这些结果凸显了基于几何的潜动作作为基于世界模型的机器人操作统一、可迁移接口的潜力。项目材料，包括演示视频和源代码，可在https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/获取。
items.comment: 15 pages, including supplementary material

items.title_en: MobileNeTTT: a Lightweight DNN-based Time-To-Transit Estimator for Visual Navigation
items.title_zh: MobileNeTTT：用于视觉导航的轻量级基于DNN的通过时间估计器
items.abstract_en: Time-to-Transit (TTT) is a perceptual cue, proxy for depth, that can be computed in the visual cortex, allowing animals to estimate the time remaining to move past features in the environment. We show how TTT can be estimated and used for bio-inspired navigation of a mobile robot equipped with a monocular camera. The paper describes a lightweight neural network estimation method, named MobileNeTTT, that (1) uses the full field of view and provides a rich array of visual feature TTT estimates; (2) is relatively insensitive to camera rotation; and (3) automatically adjusts to the geometry of the path and the presence of obstacles. Because TTT is a coarse visual cue, it is far simpler to use for robot navigation than current large visual depth foundation models. Our navigation model uses a 1.95M-parameter network that is two to three orders of magnitude smaller than well-known large vision foundation models, making it able to run in real time on edge hardware. Simulation and actual laboratory experiments validate the proposed approach in dynamic and spatially complex environments. Code, data, and video are available.
items.abstract_zh: 通过时间（Time-to-Transit, TTT）是一种感知线索，是深度的代理，可在视觉皮层中计算，使动物能够估计经过环境中特征所需的剩余时间。我们展示如何估计TTT并将其用于配备单目相机的移动机器人的仿生导航。本文描述一种轻量级神经网络估计方法，名为MobileNeTTT，其（1）使用全视场并提供丰富的视觉特征TTT估计；（2）对相机旋转相对不敏感；（3）自动适应路径几何和障碍物存在。由于TTT是一种粗略视觉线索，用于机器人导航远比当前大型视觉深度基础模型简单。我们的导航模型使用1.95M参数网络，比知名大型视觉基础模型小两到三个数量级，使其能够在边缘硬件上实时运行。仿真和实际实验室实验在动态和空间复杂环境中验证了所提方法。代码、数据和视频可用。
items.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Under review at IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)

items.title_en: Neural Fidelity Calibration for Informative Sim-to-Real Adaptation
items.title_zh: 用于信息性仿真到现实自适应的神经保真度校准
items.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) can transfer agile robot skills from simulation to the real world, but closing the sim-to-real gap by domain randomization requires expert physics knowledge, and simulator calibration from real data typically targets a few hand-picked parameters. Even then, simulators miss real-world effects, and environments reconstructed from onboard perception inherit sensing errors that limit policy improvement. We propose Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC), which uses conditional flow matching to calibrate simulator physical parameters and residual fidelity domains online during deployment. Residual fidelity captures sim-to-real dynamics discrepancies and perception-induced environment uncertainty. NFC operates in a latent space so that realistic environments can be sampled from the inferred posterior for real-to-sim policy fine-tuning. The framework is informative: the pretrained policy is fine-tuned only when an anomaly is detected, sequential NFC seeds its proposal from the simulation-pretrained estimator, and a hallucination policy modulates posterior uncertainty following optimism in the face of uncertainty. NFC attains the most accurate posteriors among established simulation-based inference methods on five robots with up to 39 physical parameters and a 128x128 residual terrain. On a wheeled robot with a broken wheel axle deployed on snow, mud, and wet grass, NFC raises success on rough terrain from 26% to 70% and reduces orientation jerk by 88%. Code and videos will be released upon publication.
items.abstract_zh: 深度强化学习（RL）可以将敏捷机器人技能从仿真迁移到真实世界，但通过域随机化缩小仿真到现实差距需要专家物理知识，而基于真实数据的模拟器校准通常只针对少数手工挑选的参数。即便如此，模拟器仍会遗漏真实世界效应，而由机载感知重建的环境会继承传感误差，从而限制策略改进。我们提出神经保真度校准（NFC），其在部署期间使用条件流匹配在线校准模拟器物理参数和残差保真域。残差保真度捕捉仿真到现实的动力学差异以及感知引起的环境不确定性。NFC在潜空间中运行，从而可以从推断的后验中采样真实感环境，用于现实到仿真的策略微调。该框架具有信息性：仅在检测到异常时才对预训练策略进行微调，序贯NFC以仿真预训练的估计器作为其提议的种子，而幻觉策略遵循面对不确定性时的乐观原则来调节后验不确定性。在五台具有多达39个物理参数和128x128残差地形的机器人上，NFC在现有基于仿真的推断方法中获得了最准确的后验。在一台轮轴损坏的轮式机器人部署于雪地、泥地和湿草地上的实验中，NFC将崎岖地形上的成功率从26%提高到70%，并将姿态加加速度降低88%。代码和视频将在论文发表后发布。
items.comment: The code and demonstration videos are available at https://www.youwei-yu.com/nfc/

items.title_en: I See You: Initial Multi-Robot LiDAR Registration with Mutual-Observation Checks
items.title_zh: 我看见你：基于相互观测校验的多机器人LiDAR初始配准
items.abstract_en: Compared to single-robot deployments, multi-robot teams can significantly improve search-and-rescue (SAR) mission success by covering large areas in parallel. To collaborate effectively, these robots must be registered in a common reference frame. Standard registration methods typically rely on external infrastructure or significant map overlap, but real deployments require infrastructure-free, stationary initial alignment for immediate operation. While global LiDAR point cloud registration addresses this, existing single-scan methods often fail silently in aliased or degenerate environments. Approaches scaling beyond two agents also remain rarely evaluated in real-world scenarios. We propose a centralized, deployment-ready framework for pre-mission multi-robot registration. Our system performs pairwise coarse-to-fine alignment and actively rejects impossible pose hypotheses via deterministic plausibility checks. We validate the framework on a real-world custom dataset of four synchronized robots in various environments with ground truth. The checks reject more than a third of the incorrect pairwise registrations while falsely rejecting less than 1% of the correct ones, and reduce the number of team registrations with a wrong robot pose by 38%. Dataset and code are publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 与单机器人部署相比，多机器人团队可通过并行覆盖大片区域，显著提高搜索与救援（SAR）任务的成功率。为有效协作，这些机器人必须在共同参考系中完成配准。标准配准方法通常依赖外部基础设施或显著的地图重叠，但实际部署需要无需基础设施、可静止完成且能立即投入运行的初始对齐。尽管全局LiDAR点云配准可解决这一问题，但现有单次扫描方法在混叠或退化环境中常常静默失败。扩展到两个以上智能体的方法在真实场景中也仍很少得到评估。我们提出一种集中式、可直接部署的框架，用于任务前多机器人配准。我们的系统执行成对粗到精对齐，并通过确定性合理性校验主动拒绝不可能的位姿假设。我们在一个真实世界自定义数据集上验证该框架，该数据集包含四台同步机器人在多种环境中的数据，并带有真值。这些校验拒绝了超过三分之一的错误成对配准，同时错误拒绝的正确配准少于1%，并将机器人位姿错误的团队配准数量减少了38%。数据集和代码已公开。
items.comment: Accepted final version. IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics (SSRR), Incheon, South Korea, November 2026. Project page: https://tu-darmstadt-ros-pkg.github.io/i-see-you-registration

items.title_en: High-Precision Docking of Differential-Drive Mobile Robots Through LiDAR and Vision Collaboration
items.title_zh: 通过LiDAR与视觉协同的差速驱动移动机器人高精度对接
items.abstract_en: Precise docking requires a differential-drive robot to correct lateral offset through coupled rotation and translation within a short approach distance. We combine global navigation with terminal control using complementary LiDAR and visual observations. A line fitted to the cabinet front gives normal distance and heading. An AprilTag identifies the workstation; intersecting its center ray with the LiDAR plane determines tangential position. Taught observations define the docking reference and can cancel repeatable fixed biases under unchanged mounting and geometry. Lateral pre-alignment and continuous visual servoing coordinate the approach, with predictive stopping to account for low-speed actuation lag. Across two sessions using the same navigation and docking code at five workstations on Robot 2, all 111 tasks completed, including 101 on the first attempt. Relative to the taught observations, onboard longitudinal, lateral and heading residual root-mean-square values were 1.51 mm, 5.93 mm and 0.238 degrees, respectively. Joint acceptance within plus or minus 10 mm per position axis and plus or minus 1 degree heading was 96.4% (107/111), or 95.5% (106/111) with a plus or minus 0.5 degree heading limit.
items.abstract_zh: 精确对接要求差速驱动机器人在短接近距离内通过旋转与平移耦合来校正横向偏移。我们利用互补的LiDAR和视觉观测，将全局导航与终端控制相结合。对柜体正面拟合的直线给出法向距离和航向。AprilTag识别工作站；将其中心射线与LiDAR平面相交确定切向位置。示教观测定义对接参考，并可在安装和几何不变的情况下消除可重复的固定偏差。横向预对准和连续视觉伺服协调接近过程，并通过预测性停止来考虑低速执行滞后。在Robot 2上五个工作站使用相同导航与对接代码的两个会话中，全部111项任务均完成，其中101项首次尝试即完成。相对于示教观测，车载纵向、横向和航向残差均方根值分别为1.51 mm、5.93 mm和0.238度。在每个位置轴±10 mm和航向±1度内的联合接受率为96.4%（107/111），在航向±0.5度限制下为95.5%（106/111）。

items.title_en: From Depth to Safe Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Monocular Perception for Mobile Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 从深度到安全深度：面向移动机器人导航的不确定性感知单目感知
items.abstract_en: Monocular depth foundation models make it tempting to replace depth sensors on mobile robots with a single RGB camera. We show that, used off the shelf, this is unsafe: in a simulated indoor navigation benchmark, a standard Nav2 stack driven by Depth Anything V2 (metric) collides in 63\% of 120 episodes, because the model systematically over-estimates the distance to nearby obstacles. We propose a lightweight plug-in module that turns predicted depth into \emph{safe depth}. A 0.58\,M-parameter head on top of the \emph{frozen} depth model predicts, per pixel, a log-depth correction $μ$ and an uncertainty $σ$, trained with a $β$-weighted Gaussian negative log-likelihood. The navigation stack consumes the one-sided bound $\hat d_{\text{safe}}=d\,e^{μ-kσ}$, where $k$ is set by conformal calibration on a held-out world, and uncertainty also decides which pixels may be treated as floor. The correction halves the depth error (AbsRel $0.262\rightarrow0.134$) and reduces near-range over-estimation from 59.8\% to 12.0\%. In navigation, safe depth raises the success rate from 37\% to 70\% and lowers collisions from 63\% to 3\%, close to the 2\% of ground-truth depth. A constant safety margin calibrated to the same pixel coverage reaches only 30\% success because it freezes the robot; uncertainty-aware safety wins 52 of 56 discordant paired episodes against it. Gains hold on glass, texture-less walls and dark regions.
items.abstract_zh: 单目深度基础模型使人们倾向于用单个RGB相机替换移动机器人上的深度传感器。我们表明，开箱即用是不安全的：在模拟室内导航基准中，由Depth Anything V2（度量）驱动的标准Nav2栈在120个回合中的63%发生碰撞，因为该模型系统性高估到附近障碍物的距离。我们提出一种轻量级即插模块，将预测深度转换为安全深度。冻结深度模型之上的0.58M参数头逐像素预测对数深度校正 μ 和不确定性 σ，并使用β加权高斯负对数似然训练。导航栈使用单侧界 d_safe = d·e^(μ−kσ)，其中k通过在留出世界上的保形校准设定，不确定性还决定哪些像素可被视为地面。该校正将深度误差减半（AbsRel 0.262→0.134），并将近距离高估从59.8%降至12.0%。在导航中，安全深度将成功率从37%提高到70%，并将碰撞率从63%降至3%，接近真值深度的2%。按相同像素覆盖率校准的恒定安全裕度仅达到30%成功率，因为它使机器人冻结；不确定性感知安全在56个不一致配对回合中对其赢得52个。增益在玻璃、无纹理墙壁和暗区仍然成立。

items.title_en: Detector-Integrated Multi-Cue Association for Occlusion-Aware UAV Multi-Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 检测器集成的多线索关联用于遮挡感知的无人机多目标跟踪
items.abstract_en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenging because vehicles are small, visually similar, and frequently occluded, which leads to identity switches (IDSW). Appearance-based trackers such as DeepSORT rely on a standalone re-identification (ReID) network, whose per-target inference limits runtime speed, while the appearance of small or occluded vehicles remains unreliable. This paper proposes a detector-integrated multi-cue tracking framework. Lightweight projection heads are attached to the neck of the YOLOv8n detector to extract target embeddings through ROIAlign, producing detections and embeddings in a single forward pass. A multi-cue association cost then combines motion, IoU, and appearance distances with weights determined through ablation, complemented by low-score rescue and appearance-memory protection. On the UAVDT benchmark, the proposed method achieves a MOTA of 28.33, a HOTA of 31.16, and an IDF1 of 38.18 at 82.59 FPS, the best among the compared trackers in all three metrics, and reduces IDSW by 58.4\% compared with DeepSORT.
items.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）影像中的多目标跟踪（MOT）具有挑战性，因为车辆目标小、外观相似且频繁被遮挡，从而导致身份切换（IDSW）。DeepSORT 等基于外观的跟踪器依赖独立的再识别（ReID）网络，其逐目标推理限制了运行速度，而小型或被遮挡车辆的外观仍然不可靠。本文提出一种检测器集成的多线索跟踪框架。将轻量级投影头附加到 YOLOv8n 检测器的颈部，通过 ROIAlign 提取目标嵌入，在单次前向传播中生成检测结果和嵌入。随后，多线索关联代价将运动、IoU 和外观距离与通过消融确定的权重相结合，并辅以低分救援和外观记忆保护。在 UAVDT 基准上，所提方法在 82.59 FPS 下取得 28.33 的 MOTA、31.16 的 HOTA 和 38.18 的 IDF1，在三项指标上均为对比跟踪器中最佳，并且与 DeepSORT 相比将 IDSW 降低了 58.4%。

items.title_en: FALCON-S: Fixed-wing ground-effect Aerodynamics Simulator and Flight Control Learning Suite
items.title_zh: FALCON-S：固定翼地面效应空气动力学仿真器与飞行控制学习套件
items.abstract_en: We present a modular, high-fidelity simulation framework for the development and benchmarking of flight control strategies in fixed-wing aerial robots operating near the ground. Unlike existing simulators that rely on simplified or hover-oriented dynamics, our framework models full 6DoF rigid-body physics, semi-empirical ground-effect aerodynamics, actuator dynamics, sensor noise, and environmental disturbances. This physical realism, combined with modular component design, enables systematic analysis of low-altitude flight behavior under realistic conditions. The simulator supports both CPU and GPU backends via Torch and NVIDIA Warp, enabling high-throughput parallel execution suitable for large-scale reinforcement learning training and optimal control rollouts. A unified interface accommodates a range of controllers (both RL and optical control algorithms) across tasks such as altitude regulation and trajectory tracking. Cross-validation with X-Plane and JSBSim is also supported to facilitate engineering integration and visual fidelity.

items.title_en: DROID-SLAM in the Wild
items.title_zh: DROID-SLAM：在野外环境中
items.abstract_en: We present a robust, real-time RGB SLAM system that handles dynamic environments by leveraging differentiable Uncertainty-aware Bundle Adjustment. Traditional SLAM methods typically assume static scenes, leading to tracking failures in the presence of motion. Recent dynamic SLAM approaches attempt to address this challenge using predefined dynamic priors or uncertainty-aware mapping, but they remain limited when confronted with unknown dynamic objects or highly cluttered scenes where geometric mapping becomes unreliable. In contrast, our method estimates per-pixel uncertainty by exploiting multi-view visual feature inconsistency, enabling robust tracking and reconstruction even in real-world environments. The proposed system achieves state-of-the-art camera poses and scene geometry in cluttered dynamic scenarios while running in real time at around 10 FPS. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个鲁棒的实时RGB SLAM系统，通过利用可微的不确定性感知光束法平差来处理动态环境。传统SLAM方法通常假设静态场景，在存在运动时会导致跟踪失败。近期动态SLAM方法尝试使用预定义动态先验或不确定性感知建图来应对这一挑战，但在面对未知动态物体或高度杂乱、几何建图变得不可靠的场景时仍受限。相比之下，我们的方法利用多视图视觉特征不一致性估计逐像素不确定性，即使在真实世界环境中也能实现鲁棒跟踪与重建。所提出系统在杂乱的动态场景中实现最先进的相机位姿和场景几何，同时以约10 FPS实时运行。代码和数据集见 https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git。

items.title_en: Symbol Rate Maximization in Rolling-Shutter OCC: Design and Implementation Considerations
items.abstract_en: Optical Camera Communication (OCC) systems can take advantage of the row-by-row scanning process of rolling-shutter cameras to capture the fast variations of light intensity coming from Visible Light Communication (VLC) LED-based transmitters. In order to study the maximum data rate that is feasible in such kind of OCC systems, this paper presents its equivalent digital communication system model in which the rolling-shutter camera is modeled as a rectangular matched-filter whose time width is equal to the exposure time of the camera, followed by a sampling process at the pixel row sweep rate of the camera. Based on the proposed rolling-shutter camera model, the maximum symbol rate that such OCC systems can support is experimentally demonstrated, and the impact of imperfect time synchronization between the VLC transmitter and the rolling-shutter OCC receiver is characterized in the form of Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI). The equivalent three-tap channel model that results from this process is experimentally validated and the generated ISI is compensated with the use of linear equalization in reception. Simulation and experimental results show a strong correlation between them, demonstrating that the proposed approach can be used to make the OCC system work at the Nyquist sampling rate, which is equivalent to the pixel row sweep rate of the rolling-shutter camera used in reception.
items.title_zh: 卷帘快门OCC中的符号速率最大化：设计与实现考量
items.abstract_zh: 光学相机通信（OCC）系统可利用卷帘快门相机的逐行扫描过程，捕获可见光通信（VLC）LED发射机光强的快速变化。为研究此类OCC系统可实现的最大数据速率，本文将卷帘快门相机等效为时间宽度等于曝光时间的矩形匹配滤波器，其后按相机像素行扫描速率进行采样，从而建立等效数字通信系统模型。基于该模型，实验验证了系统可支持的最大符号速率，并将VLC发射机与OCC接收机之间时间同步不完美的影响刻画为符号间干扰（ISI）。实验验证了由此得到的等效三抽头信道模型，并在接收端采用线性均衡补偿产生的ISI。仿真与实验结果高度吻合，表明该方法可使OCC系统工作在奈奎斯特采样速率，即接收所用卷帘快门相机的像素行扫描速率。
items.highlight_zh: 将卷帘快门相机建模为矩形匹配滤波器，实现奈奎斯特速率传输
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：可见光通信中，用普通卷帘快门相机当接收机（即OCC）时，相机的逐行扫描恰好能记录LED光强的快速明暗变化。但这类系统的速率上限到底是多少、受什么限制，此前缺乏系统分析。

二、用了什么方法：作者把相机等效成通信系统中的“矩形匹配滤波器”——其积分时间就是相机曝光时间，之后以像素行扫描速率进行采样，从而得到一个可与经典数字通信理论对接的等效模型。在此模型下，作者实验测出了可支持的最大符号速率，并把发射端与接收端时间不同步造成的后果，统一刻画为符号间干扰（ISI），进而推出一个等效三抽头信道模型，并在接收端用线性均衡加以补偿。

三、有什么结果：仿真与实测结果高度一致，验证了三抽头信道模型的正确性；线性均衡能有效消除失配带来的ISI，使系统在奈奎斯特速率下工作，也就是恰好等于相机像素行扫描速率——即每个像素行承载一个符号，不留冗余。

四、为何重要：这给出了OCC系统速率设计的“理论天花板”与工程做法。过去设计者常靠降低速率来躲避同步误差，本文说明只要建模正确、接收端做均衡，就能把相机扫描速率用满，为高速相机通信的实用化提供了可操作的准则。

items.title_en: LuxTac: A Flexible, Scalable, and Open-Source Optical Taxel Array with Distributed Three-Axis Force Sensing for Tactile Robot Learning
items.title_zh: LuxTac：一种用于触觉机器人学习的柔性、可扩展、开源且具备分布式三轴力感知的光学触觉像素阵列
items.abstract_en: Low-cost tactile arrays have made touch a practical input for robot learning, but piezoresistive designs sense only pressure, while camera-based sensors that also resolve shear are too bulky to tile over a gripper. To solve this problem, we present LuxTac, a flexible, scalable optical taxel array, about 3.5 mm thick and built from off-the-shelf parts. Each taxel is a digital RGBC light-to-digital converter under a translucent white silicone layer capped by an opaque black film, so the back-scattered LED light falls monotonically with local indentation depth. The same board accepts two interchangeable gel cartridges: a plain one for normal sensing, and one with colored walls that encodes the local shear in the color of the returned light, with no camera, magnets, or bump overlay, making LuxTac, to our knowledge, the first optical taxel array to resolve shear at individual taxels. Characterized with an automated CNC indenter and a six-axis force/torque sensor, the normal cartridge responds linearly to force ($R^2$ = 0.999) from 104 mN to at least 5.8 N, with 2.0% repeatability, 5.9% hysteresis, and a taxel-to-taxel variation of 6-10% after normalization. With the shear cartridge, per-taxel models estimate the three-axis force at every taxel; across three indenter shapes and nine held-out sessions, the summed estimates reach $R^2$ = 0.96/0.96/0.92 in x/y/z, each taxel's estimate 0.92/0.93/0.94, and the median shear-direction error is 4.8 degrees. Adding LuxTac pressure readings to an Action Chunking Transformer policy substantially improves peg-in-hole success over a vision-only baseline. Design files, code, and videos are available at https://luxtac.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 低成本触觉阵列使触觉成为机器人学习的一种实用输入，但压阻式设计仅感知压力，而同时可解析剪切力的基于相机的传感器又过于笨重，难以在夹爪上铺满。为解决此问题，我们提出 LuxTac，一种柔性、可扩展的光学触觉像素阵列，厚度约 3.5 mm，由现成部件构建。每个触觉像素是一个数字 RGBC 光数字转换器，位于半透明白色硅胶层下，并由不透明黑色薄膜覆盖，因此背散射 LED 光随局部压入深度单调下降。同一块板可接受两种可互换的凝胶盒：普通凝胶盒用于法向感知；带彩色壁的凝胶盒将局部剪切编码到返回光的颜色中，无需相机、磁体或凸点覆盖层，据我们所知，这使 LuxTac 成为首个在单个触觉像素上解析剪切力的光学触觉像素阵列。使用自动 CNC 压头和六轴力/力矩传感器进行表征，普通凝胶盒在 104 mN 至至少 5.8 N 范围内对力呈线性响应（R² = 0.999），重复性为 2.0%，滞回为 5.9%，归一化后触觉像素间差异为 6–10%。使用剪切凝胶盒时，逐触觉像素模型估计每个触觉像素处的三轴力；在三种压头形状和九个留出会话中，求和估计在 x/y/z 方向达到 R² = 0.96/0.96/0.92，每个触觉像素的估计为 0.92/0.93/0.94，剪切方向误差中位数为 4.8 度。将 LuxTac 压力读数加入 Action Chunking Transformer 策略后，相比仅视觉基线，插孔任务成功率显著提高。设计文件、代码和视频见 https://luxtac.github.io。

items.title_en: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
items.title_zh: Generalized-CVO：基于二阶黎曼优化的快速无对应局部点云配准
items.abstract_en: We propose a fast and correspondence-free local point cloud registration method that leverages geometric surface structure and reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) embeddings. The method represents point clouds as continuous functions with point-wise anisotropic kernels that encode local geometry. This formulation improves alignment along surface normals while relaxing alignment along tangential directions. To solve the resulting registration problem, we propose a second-order on-manifold optimization scheme with approximate Riemannian Hessians, achieving a speedup of up to 10x over the first-order solvers used in prior correspondence-free RKHS-based methods. We demonstrate improved frame-to-frame LiDAR and RGB-D tracking accuracy across diverse indoor and outdoor datasets. On a LiDAR tracking registration task in the driving domain, we achieve a reduction of >55% in both translational and rotational drift in challenging feature-sparse environments. On object registration benchmarks, we show improved robustness over ICP-based methods and further gains when refining global initialization, particularly under moderate misalignment.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种快速且无对应的局部点云配准方法，利用几何表面结构和再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）嵌入。该方法将点云表示为具有逐点各向异性核的连续函数，这些核编码局部几何。该形式改善了沿表面法向的对齐，同时放宽了沿切向方向的对齐。为求解所得配准问题，我们提出一种采用近似黎曼Hessian的二阶流形优化方案，相较于先前无对应RKHS方法中使用的一阶求解器，实现最高10倍的加速。我们在多样化的室内和室外数据集上展示了帧到帧LiDAR和RGB-D跟踪精度的提升。在驾驶领域的LiDAR跟踪配准任务中，我们在具有挑战性的特征稀疏环境中将平移和旋转漂移均降低超过55%。在物体配准基准上，我们展示了相较于基于ICP的方法更好的鲁棒性，并且在精化全局初始化时获得进一步增益，尤其是在中等程度失配下。

items.title_en: Noise Mitigation Methods for Digital Visible Light Communication
items.title_zh: 数字可见光通信的噪声抑制方法
items.abstract_en: Visible Light Communication (VLC) using Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) has gained attention due to its low power consumption, long lifetime, and fast response. However, VLC suffers from optical noise generated by ambient light sources such as fluorescent lamps, which leads to waveform distortion and increased bit error rates (BER). In this paper, we propose two noise reduction methods for Digital Visible Light Communication (DVLC) systems. The first method exploits the periodic nature of interference caused by AC-powered-line illumination and reduces interference by subtracting sampled noise waveforms from the received signal. Second, inspired by Active Noise Control (ANC) techniques, an additional photodiode is introduced for noise reception, and subtraction circuits are employed to attenuate noise in real time. Experimental results show that both methods improve BER performance compared with conventional receivers, with the ANC-inspired approach achieving superior performance under all tested conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 使用发光二极管（LED）的可见光通信（VLC）因其低功耗、长寿命和快速响应而受到关注。然而，VLC受到荧光灯等环境光源产生的光学噪声影响，导致波形失真和误码率（BER）升高。本文针对数字可见光通信（DVLC）系统提出两种降噪方法。第一种方法利用交流供电线路照明所造成干扰的周期性，通过从接收信号中减去采样噪声波形来降低干扰。第二种方法受主动噪声控制（ANC）技术启发，引入额外光电二极管接收噪声，并采用减法电路实时衰减噪声。实验结果表明，与常规接收机相比，两种方法均改善了BER性能，其中受ANC启发的方法在所有测试条件下取得更优性能。

items.title_en: Exposure-Aware Informative Path Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 使用深度强化学习的暴露感知信息路径规划
items.abstract_en: This paper addresses the finite-budget exposure-aware informative path planning (IPP) problem for a fleet of mobile sensing agents. The agents map an unknown scalar field while limiting exposure to high field intensity. Existing IPP methods optimize informativeness under motion or resource constraints, but do not address field exposure constraints. We formulate exposure-aware IPP (EA-IPP) as a scalarized bi-objective belief-state Markov decision process that trades the normalized Gaussian-process (GP) information gain against a normalized measurement-derived fleet exposure index. A parameter-shared proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework with decentralized actors and a centralized fleet critic is trained offline and evaluated on unseen fields. Across the radar, plume, and wildfire field families, the EA-IPP agent achieves the lowest GP reconstruction RMSE among the evaluated baselines while retaining D-optimal information within $10\%$ of the non-learning information baseline. The minimum field exposure is approximately $34.6\%$, $20.1\%$, and $27\%$ below the non-exposure-aware baseline for radar, plume, and wildfire, respectively.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究一组移动传感智能体在有限预算下的暴露感知信息路径规划（IPP）问题。智能体在限制对高场强暴露的同时，对未知标量场进行建图。现有 IPP 方法在运动或资源约束下优化信息量，但未处理场暴露约束。我们将暴露感知 IPP（EA-IPP）表述为一个标量化双目标信念状态马尔可夫决策过程，在归一化高斯过程（GP）信息增益与归一化测量导出的车队暴露指数之间进行权衡。采用参数共享的近端策略优化（PPO）框架，包含去中心化 actor 和中心化车队 critic，离线训练并在未见场上评估。在雷达、羽流和野火场族中，EA-IPP 智能体在所评估基线中取得最低的 GP 重建 RMSE，同时将 D-最优信息保持在非学习信息基线的 10% 以内。对于雷达、羽流和野火，最小场暴露分别比非暴露感知基线低约 34.6%、20.1% 和 27%。

items.title_en: An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 一种用于视觉目标跟踪的高效Token压缩框架
items.abstract_en: Refining visual representations by eliminating their internal feature-level redundancy is crucial for simultaneously optimizing the performance and computational cost of models in visual tracking. To enhance their performance, many contemporary Transformer-based trackers leverage a larger number of historical template frames to capture richer spatio-temporal cues. However, this strategy leads to a massive number of input visual tokens. This creates two critical issues: it imposes a quadratic computational burden and can also degrade the tracker's overall performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a compress-then-interact tracking framework, ETCTrack, that learns to efficiently compress template tokens from historical template frames into a robust target representation, moving beyond handcrafted rules. Our method first employs the Adaptive Token Compressor to dynamically construct compact yet highly discriminative template tokens by filtering out redundant visual tokens. These refined template tokens are then processed by our Hierarchical Interaction Encoder to achieve a deep, adaptive interaction with the search features. Refined search features ensure subsequent precise target localization. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art trackers. ETCTrack-B224 reduces the number of template tokens by 60%, leading to a 21.4% reduction in MACs with only a 0.4% drop in accuracy. The source code are available at https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack.
items.abstract_zh: 通过消除视觉表示内部的特征级冗余来精炼视觉表示，对于同时优化视觉跟踪模型的性能和计算成本至关重要。为提升性能，许多当代基于Transformer的跟踪器利用更多历史模板帧来捕获更丰富的时空线索。然而，这一策略会导致输入视觉Token数量巨大。这带来两个关键问题：造成二次计算负担，并且还可能降低跟踪器的整体性能。为弥补这一差距，我们提出一种先压缩后交互的跟踪框架ETCTrack，它学习将历史模板帧中的模板Token高效压缩为鲁棒的目标表示，超越手工设计的规则。我们的方法首先采用自适应Token压缩器，通过滤除冗余视觉Token来动态构建紧凑且高度判别性的模板Token。随后，这些精炼后的模板Token由我们的分层交互编码器处理，以与搜索特征实现深度、自适应的交互。精炼后的搜索特征确保后续精确的目标定位。在七个基准上的实验表明，我们的方法优于当前最先进的跟踪器。ETCTrack-B224将模板Token数量减少60%，使MACs降低21.4%，而精度仅下降0.4%。源代码见 https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack。

items.title_en: Visible Light Communication using Led-Based AR Markers for Robot Localization
items.title_zh: 基于 LED 的 AR 标记用于机器人定位的可见光通信
items.abstract_en: A method of information transmission using visual markers has been widely studied. In this approach, information or identifiers (IDs) are encoded in the black-and-white pattern of each marker. By analyzing the geometric properties of the marker frame - such as its size, distortion, and coordinates - the relative position and orientation between the camera and the marker can be estimated. Furthermore, by associating the positional information of each marker with its corresponding ID, the position of the camera that takes the image picture can be calculated. In the field of mobile robotics, such markers are commonly utilized for robot localization. As mobile robots become more widely used in everyday environments, such visual markers are expected to be utilized across various contexts. In environments where robots collaborate with humans - such as in cell-based manufacturing systems in factories or in domestic settings with partner robots - it is desirable for such markers to be designed in a manner that appears natural and unobtrusive to humans. In this paper, we propose a method for implementing an ArUco marker in the form of illumination. In the proposed method, LEDs are arranged in accordance with the grid pattern of the marker, and the blinking frequency of each LED is determined based on the corresponding black or white cell. As a result, the illumination appears uniformly bright to the human eye, while the camera can capture variations in the blinking frequency. From these differences, the black-and-white pattern can be reconstructed, enabling the identification of the marker's tag information. We develop a prototype system, and conduct experiments which are conducted to evaluate its performance in terms of recognition accuracy under varying distances and viewing angles with respect to the ArUco marker.
items.abstract_zh: 使用视觉标记进行信息传输的方法已被广泛研究。在这种方法中，信息或标识符（ID）被编码在每个标记的黑白图案中。通过分析标记框的几何属性——例如其尺寸、畸变和坐标——可以估计相机与标记之间的相对位置和姿态。此外，通过将每个标记的位置信息与其对应的 ID 关联，可以计算出拍摄图像的相机位置。在移动机器人领域，此类标记通常用于机器人定位。随着移动机器人在日常环境中得到更广泛使用，此类视觉标记有望在各种场景中得到应用。在机器人与人类协作的环境中——例如工厂中基于单元的生产系统，或与伙伴机器人共处的家庭环境——此类标记宜设计得对人类显得自然且不突兀。本文提出一种以照明形式实现 ArUco 标记的方法。在所提方法中，LED 按照标记的网格图案排列，每个 LED 的闪烁频率根据对应的黑色或白色单元格确定。因此，该照明对人眼呈现为均匀明亮，而相机可以捕捉闪烁频率的变化。根据这些差异，可以重建黑白图案，从而能够识别标记的标签信息。我们开发了一个原型系统，并开展实验，评估其在相对于 ArUco 标记的不同距离和视角下的识别准确率性能。

items.title_en: Smart Visual Beacons with Asynchronous Optical Communications using Event Cameras
items.abstract_en: Event cameras are bio-inspired dynamic vision sensors that respond to changes in image intensity with a high temporal resolution, high dynamic range and low latency. These sensor characteristics are ideally suited to enable visual target tracking in concert with a broadcast visual communication channel for smart visual beacons with applications in distributed robotics. Visual beacons can be constructed by high-frequency modulation of Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) such as vehicle headlights, Internet of Things (IoT) LEDs, smart building lights, etc., that are already present in many real-world scenarios. The high temporal resolution characteristic of the event cameras allows them to capture visual signals at far higher data rates compared to classical frame-based cameras. In this paper, we propose a novel smart visual beacon architecture with both LED modulation and event camera demodulation algorithms. We quantitatively evaluate the relationship between LED transmission rate, communication distance and the message transmission accuracy for the smart visual beacon communication system that we prototyped. The proposed method achieves up to 4 kbps in an indoor environment and lossless transmission over a distance of 100 meters, at a transmission rate of 500 bps, in full sunlight, demonstrating the potential of the technology in an outdoor environment.

items.abstract_zh: 事件相机是受生物启发的动态视觉传感器，以高时间分辨率、高动态范围和低延迟响应图像强度的变化。这些传感器特性非常适合与广播视觉通信信道协同实现视觉目标跟踪，用于分布式机器人等应用中的智能视觉信标。视觉信标可以通过对许多现实场景中已存在的 LED（如车辆前照灯、物联网 LED、智能建筑灯等）进行高频调制来构建。事件相机的高时间分辨率特性使其能够以远高于经典基于帧相机的数据速率捕获视觉信号。本文提出一种新颖的智能视觉信标架构，包含 LED 调制和事件相机解调算法。我们针对所原型的智能视觉信标通信系统，定量评估 LED 传输速率、通信距离与消息传输准确率之间的关系。所提方法在室内环境中达到最高 4 kbps，并在全日照下以 500 bps 的传输速率实现 100 米距离的无损传输，展示了该技术在室外环境中的潜力。

items.title_en: E-VLC: A Real-World Dataset for Event-based Visible Light Communication And Localization
items.abstract_en: Optical communication using modulated LEDs (e.g., visible light communication) is an emerging application for event cameras, thanks to their high spatio-temporal resolutions. Event cameras can be used simply to decode the LED signals and also to localize the camera relative to the LED marker positions. However, there is no public dataset to benchmark the decoding and localization in various real-world settings. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first public dataset that consists of an event camera, a frame camera, and ground-truth poses that are precisely synchronized with hardware triggers. It provides various camera motions with various sensitivities in different scene brightness settings, both indoor and outdoor. Furthermore, we propose a novel method of localization that leverages the Contrast Maximization framework for motion estimation and compensation. The detailed analysis and experimental results demonstrate the advantages of LED-based localization with events over the conventional AR-marker--based one with frames, as well as the efficacy of the proposed method in localization. We hope that the proposed dataset serves as a future benchmark for both motion-related classical computer vision tasks and LED marker decoding tasks simultaneously, paving the way to broadening applications of event cameras on mobile devices. https://woven-visionai.github.io/evlc-dataset
items.title_zh: E-VLC：用于基于事件的可见光通信与定位的真实世界数据集
items.abstract_zh: 使用调制 LED 的光通信（例如可见光通信）是事件相机的一个新兴应用，这得益于其高时空分辨率。事件相机既可用于简单地解码 LED 信号，也可用于相对于 LED 标记位置对相机进行定位。然而，尚无公开数据集用于在各种真实世界设置中对解码和定位进行基准测试。我们提出了据我们所知的首个公开数据集，该数据集由事件相机、帧相机以及与硬件触发精确同步的真值位姿组成。它提供了在室内和室外不同场景亮度设置下具有各种灵敏度的多种相机运动。此外，我们提出了一种新的定位方法，利用对比度最大化框架进行运动估计和补偿。详细分析和实验结果展示了基于事件的 LED 定位相对于基于帧的传统 AR 标记定位的优势，以及所提方法在定位中的有效性。我们希望所提出的数据集能够同时作为未来与运动相关的经典计算机视觉任务和 LED 标记解码任务的基准，为拓宽事件相机在移动设备上的应用铺平道路。https://woven-visionai.github.io/evlc-dataset

items.title_en: Arboreus: A Realistic Boreal Forest Simulator with Topographic Terrain and Satellite-Informed Parametric Tree Distributions
items.title_zh: Arboreus：一个具有地形地貌与卫星信息参数化树木分布的真实感北方森林模拟器
items.abstract_en: This work presents Arboreus, a realistic Boreal forest simulator, developed to support statistical validation of robotic autonomy algorithms in Boreal forest environments. Arboreus presents an automated methodology for synthesizing large-scale, data-informed, plausible forest worlds from parametric trees, height-variant terrain, and satellite-informed tree density distributions. The parametric generation of dominant Boreal tree species such as Birch, Spruce, and Pine is guided by trunk, canopy, and foliage parameters, extracted from growth studies in the Nordic areas. Tree distribution in an area of interest is guided by the Copernicus satellite dataset, which provides tree cover density and dominant species type at up to 10m raster resolution. The forest floor generation is guided by topographic data from the Swedish cadastral agency to produce realistic data-informed terrains. Given coordinates and extents of forested areas of interest, Arboreus synthesizes data-informed plausible forests, while offering flexibility to inject user observations of real forests (detail, age, dimensionality and tree count), which is critical for realistic synthetic data generation and for the testing of feature-sensitive autonomy algorithms. The applicability of Arboreus for benchmarking and validation of robot autonomy for different robot mobilities is demonstrated in Gazebosim, Unreal Engine, and Isaac Sim physics engines. The applicability of Arboreus as a source of synthetic forest data and its potential to support downstream forest resource mapping research (volume estimation, tree instance segmentation and stem attribute estimation) is also demonstrated. Arboreus has been open-sourced along with a dataset comprising 25 Boreal forest worlds of size 1000m2 corresponding to three real forest sites.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Arboreus，一个真实感北方森林模拟器，旨在支持北方森林环境中机器人自主算法的统计验证。Arboreus 提出一种自动化方法，利用参数化树木、高度变化地形和卫星信息树木密度分布，合成大规模、数据驱动、合理的森林世界。桦树、云杉和松树等优势北方树种的参数化生成，由树干、树冠和枝叶参数指导，这些参数提取自北欧地区的生长研究。感兴趣区域内的树木分布由 Copernicus 卫星数据集指导，该数据集提供高达 10m 栅格分辨率的树木覆盖密度和优势树种类型。森林地表生成由瑞典地籍局的地形数据指导，以生成真实感的数据驱动地形。给定感兴趣林区的坐标和范围，Arboreus 合成数据驱动的合理森林，同时提供灵活性以注入用户对真实森林的观测（细节、年龄、维度和树木数量），这对于真实感合成数据生成以及测试对特征敏感的自主算法至关重要。在 Gazebosim、Unreal Engine 和 Isaac Sim 物理引擎中，展示了 Arboreus 用于不同机器人移动能力的机器人自主性基准测试与验证的适用性。还展示了 Arboreus 作为合成森林数据来源的适用性，以及其支持下游森林资源测绘研究（体积估计、树木实例分割和树干属性估计）的潜力。Arboreus 已开源，并附带一个数据集，包含 25 个大小为 1000m² 的北方森林世界，对应三个真实森林样地。

items.title_zh: SBTenv：一个经文献验证的分带跑步机仿真环境
items.abstract_en: The split-belt treadmill is an important tool for studying human locomotor adaptation. Physics-based simulations complement such experiments by allowing hypotheses about the mechanisms of adaptation to be tested directly, and high-throughput simulation is increasingly needed as these models grow in complexity. However, no open-source split-belt treadmill environment exists in MuJoCo, a physics engine widely used for high-throughput simulation. Here, we present SBTenv, a split-belt treadmill environment built in MuJoCo and validated against published experimental data from a rimless wheel walking passively on a split-belt treadmill. By modeling compliant contacts at the spoke tips, SBTenv reproduces the experimental average steady velocity ($R^2=0.643$, RMSE $=0.0162$ m/s) without the empirical geometric correction required in prior simulations. We expect SBTenv, openly shared, to enable high-throughput simulation of musculoskeletal and robotic locomotion on a split-belt treadmill.
items.abstract_zh: 分带跑步机是研究人类运动适应的重要工具。基于物理的仿真通过允许直接检验关于适应机制的假设来补充此类实验，并且随着这些模型日益复杂，对高通量仿真的需求不断增加。然而，在广泛用于高通量仿真的物理引擎MuJoCo中，尚不存在开源的分带跑步机环境。在此，我们提出SBTenv，一个在MuJoCo中构建的分带跑步机环境，并依据已发表的、无轮缘轮在分带跑步机上被动行走的实验数据进行验证。通过在轮辐尖端建模柔性接触，SBTenv复现了实验平均稳态速度（$R^2=0.643$，RMSE $=0.0162$ m/s），而无需先前仿真中所需的经验几何校正。我们期望公开共享的SBTenv能够支持在分带跑步机上进行肌肉骨骼与机器人运动的高通量仿真。
